```python
        if fund_type in EQUITY_MF_TYPES:
            if long_term:
                ltcg_112a += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a += gain
        elif fund_type in NON_EQUITY_MF_TYPES:
            if long_term:
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain

    # Bonds, debentures and Government securities.
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(key) or {}
        sale_amount = num(asset.get("Sale Amount"))
        purchase_amount = num(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        years = num(asset.get("Held for duration in years"))
        gain = sale_amount - purchase_amount
        if years > 1:
            ltcg_non_equity[key] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[key] += gain

    # Privately owned vehicle (unlisted, hence "other" capital gains).
    vehicle = data.get("Privately Owned Vehicle") or {}
    vehicle_gain = num(vehicle.get("Sale Amount")) - num(vehicle.get("Purchase Amount"))
    vehicle_years = num(vehicle.get("Held for duration in years"))
    if vehicle_gain:
        if vehicle_years > 1:
            ltcg_other += vehicle_gain
        else:
            stcg_other_vehicle += vehicle_gain

    # Losses declared by the taxpayer.
    stcl_losses = []
    for loss in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or []:
        amount = num(loss.get("Loss Amount"))
        if amount:
            stcl_losses.append([fy_start_year(loss.get("Financial Year")), amount])

    ltcl_losses = []
    for loss in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or []:
        amount = num(loss.get("Loss Amount"))
        if amount:
            ltcl_losses.append([fy_start_year(loss.get("Financial Year")), amount])

    # Negative category balances are treated as losses of the current year.
    if stcg_111a < 0:
        stcl_losses.append([CURRENT_FY_START_YEAR, -stcg_111a])
        stcg_111a = 0.0
    if stcg_other_vehicle < 0:

    for key in stcg_other:

    if ltcg_112a < 0:

    if ltcg_other < 0:

    for key in ltcg_non_equity:

            ltcl_losses.append([CURRENT_FY_START_YEAR, -ltcg_non_equity[key]])

    # Mutable cells so that set-offs can consume gains in place.
    stcg_111a_cell = [stcg_111a]
    ltcg_112a_cell = [ltcg_112a]
    stcg_other_scalars = [[stcg_other_vehicle]]
    ltcg_other_scalars = [[ltcg_other]]
    stcg_other_buckets = [(stcg_other, k) for k in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")]
    ltcg_non_equity_buckets = [(ltcg_non_equity, k) for k in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")]

    # Set-off order (CBDT):
    #  (i)   STCL set off against STCG;
    #  (ii)  LTCG set off against STCL;
    #  (iii) STCL of earlier years (pre FY 2018-19) set off against LTCG;
    #  (iv)  LTCL set off against STCG.

    for entry in stcl_losses:

    for entry in stcl_losses:

        remaining -= take(remaining, [], [ltcg_112a_cell])
        remaining -= take(remaining, ltcg_non_equity_buckets, ltcg_other_scalars)
        entry[1] = remaining

    for entry in ltcl_losses:

            continue
        remaining = entry[1]
        remaining -= take(remaining, [], [stcg_111a_cell])
        remaining -= take(remaining, stcg_other_buckets, stcg_other_scalars)
        entry[1] = remaining

    ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a_cell[0]

    ltcg_non_equity_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())

    deposit_interest = num(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = num(data.get("Other Interest"))

    other_sources_total = savings_interest + deposit_interest + other_interest + epf_interest

    gross_total_income = (net_salary + other_sources_total + stcg_111a +

                          ltcg_other)

    # ------------------------------- Deductions --------------------------
    epf = data.get("EPF") or {}
    employee_contribution = epf.get("Employee Contribution") or {}

    section_80c = 0.0
    if old_regime:

        section_80c += num(employee_contribution.get("Deducted from Salary"))
        section_80c += num(employee_contribution.get("Voluntary"))
        section_80c += num(data.get("ELSS"))
        section_80c += num(data.get("NSC"))
        section_80c += num(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
        section_80c += num(data.get("SCSS"))
        section_80c = min(section_80c, LIMIT_80C)

    pension_years = num(pension.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1) or 1
    section_80ccc = 0.0
    if old_regime:

    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_self = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    nps_employer = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    nps_tier2 = num(nps.get("Tier-2"))

    section_80ccd1 = min(nps_self + nps_employer, LIMIT_80CCD1)
    section_80ccd1b = min(nps_tier2, LIMIT_80CCD1B)
    section_80ccd2 = min(nps_employer, 0.10 * (basic + dearness))

    if old_regime:

        parent_premium = 0.0
        parent_senior = False
        for policy in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
            paid_by = str(policy.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
            mode = str(policy.get("Payment Mode") or "").strip().lower()
            beneficiary = str(policy.get("Beneficiary") or "").strip().lower()
            years = num(policy.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1) or 1
            amount = num(policy.get("Amount"))
            if paid_by in ("group medical insurance", "group", "employer"):
                continue
            if mode == "cash":
                continue
            per_year = amount / years
            if "parent" in beneficiary:
                parent_premium += per_year
                if num(policy.get("Beneficiary Age")) >= 60:
                    parent_senior = True
            else:
                self_premium += per_year
        self_limit = LIMIT_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else LIMIT_80D_SELF

        section_80d = min(self_premium, self_limit) + min(parent_premium, parent_limit)

    if old_regime:

            if mode == "cash":

            amount = num(donation.get("Amount"))
            rate, qualifying_limit = donation_rate(donation.get("Scheme Name"))
            if rate >= 1.0:

            elif qualifying_limit:
                section_80g += min(0.5 * amount, 0.10 * gross_total_income)
            else:
                section_80g += min(0.5 * amount, LIMIT_80G_50_WITHOUT_LIMIT)

    section_80tta = 0.0
    section_80ttb = 0.0

        section_80tta = min(savings_interest, tta_limit)
        if age >= 60:
            section_80ttb = min(deposit_interest, LIMIT_80TTB)

                        section_80ccd2 + section_80d + section_80e + section_80g +

    rebate = 0.0

    if total_taxable_income > 5000000:

        elif total_taxable_income <= 20000000:

        else:
```

            "Total": 0
        },
        "LTCG (Section 112A)": 0,
        "LTCG (Non-Equity)": {
            "Bonds": 0,
            "Debentures": 0,
            "G-Secs": 0,
            "Mutual Funds": 0,
            "Total": 0
        },
        "LTCG (Other)": 0
    },
    "Income from Other Sources": {
        "Savings Bank Interest": 0,
        "Deposit Interest": 0,
        "Other Interest": 0,
        "EPF Taxable Interest": 0
    },
    "Gross Total Income": 0,
    "Deductions": {
        "80C": 0,
        "80CCC": 0,
        "80CCD(1)": 0,
        "80CCD(1B)": 0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0,
        "80D": 0,
        "80E": 0,
        "80G": 0,
        "80TTA": 0,
        "80TTB": 0,
        "Total Deductions": 0
    },
    "Total Taxable Income": 0,
    "Tax Computation": {
        "Tax at Slab Rates": 0,
        "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": 0,
        "Tax on STCG (Other)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Other)": 0,
        "Total Tax Before Rebate": 0,

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Indian income-tax calculator - FY 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27).

Reads the taxpayer profile from 'input.json' in the current working directory,
computes the complete tax outcome and prints it as a single JSON object on
stdout (nothing else is written to stdout).

Only the Python standard library is used.
"""

import json
from datetime import date

INPUT_FILE = "input.json"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Statutory parameters - FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Section 115BAC (new regime) slabs: (upper bound, rate); None = no upper bound
NEW_SLABS = (
    (300_000, 0.00),
    (700_000, 0.05),
    (1_000_000, 0.10),
    (1_200_000, 0.15),
    (1_500_000, 0.20),
    (None, 0.30),
)

# Old regime slabs
OLD_SLABS = (
    (250_000, 0.00),
    (500_000, 0.05),
    (1_000_000, 0.20),
    (None, 0.30),
)

STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = 75_000          # Sec. 16(ia) - new regime
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = 50_000          # Sec. 16(ia) - old regime

REBATE_NEW_LIMIT = 1_200_000        # Sec. 87A - new regime
REBATE_NEW_MAX = 60_000
REBATE_OLD_LIMIT = 500_000          # Sec. 87A - old regime
REBATE_OLD_MAX = 12_500

LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION = 125_000       # Sec. 112A(2) - Rs 1,25,000 p.a.
RATE_112A = 0.125                   # Sec. 112A - 12.5% without indexation
RATE_LTCG_NON_EQUITY = 0.125        # Sec. 112 - 12.5% (debt MF, bonds, etc.)
RATE_LTCG_OTHER = 0.25              # Sec. 112 - 25% (unlisted / other assets)
CESS_RATE = 0.04                    # Health & Education Cess

# Schemes eligible for a 100% deduction under Sec. 80G (all others: 50%)
FULL_DEDUCTION_SCHEMES = {
    "national defence fund",
    "national foundation for disaster management",
    "pm relief fund",
    "prime minister's national relief fund",
    "prime minister relief fund",
    "chief minister's relief fund",
    "chief minister relief fund",
    "swachh bharat kosh",
    "national war memorial",
    "armed forces flag day fund",
    "national disaster management authority",
    "zetel",
}

EQUITY_FUND_TYPES = {"equity", "elss", "hybrid-equity"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def num(value, default=0.0):
    """Coerce a JSON value to a float (never raises)."""
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    try:
        return float(str(value).replace(",", "").strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def parse_date(value):
    """Parse a date string in any of the usual formats; None if unparseable."""
    if not value:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d-%b-%Y"):
        try:
            return date(*date.strptime(text, fmt)[:3])
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def holding_days(purchase, sale):
    """Number of days between the purchase and the sale date."""
    d1, d2 = parse_date(purchase), parse_date(sale)
    if d1 is None or d2 is None:
        return 0
    return (d2 - d1).days


def fy_start_year(fy):
    """'2023-24' -> 2023 (start year of the financial year)."""
    try:
        return int(str(fy).split("-")[0])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def slab_tax(income, slabs):
    """Tax on `income` under a cumulative slab structure."""
    if income <= 0:
        return 0.0
    tax, lower = 0.0, 0.0
    for upper, rate in slabs:
        if upper is None:
            tax += (income - lower) * rate
            break
        if income > lower:
            tax += (min(income, upper) - lower) * rate
        lower = upper
    return tax


def surcharge_rate(income, is_new):
    """Surcharge rate applicable on the total income."""
    if income > 50_000_000:
        if income <= 100_000_000:
            return 0.10
        if income <= 200_000_000:
            return 0.15
        if income <= 500_000_000:
            return 0.25
        return 0.25 if is_new else 0.37
    return 0.0


def r2(value):
    """Round to 2 decimals for the output."""
    return round(float(value) + 0.0, 2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def calculate(data):
    age = num(data.get("Age"))
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type") or "private").strip().lower()
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime") or "new").strip().lower()
    city = str(data.get("City") or "non-metro").strip().lower()

    is_new = regime == "new"
    is_metro = city == "metro"
    is_government = employment == "government"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Under the head "Salaries"
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    salary_parts = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    gross_salary = sum(num(v) for v in salary_parts.values())
    basic = num(salary_parts.get("Basic Salary"))
    da = num(salary_parts.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    hra_received = num(salary_parts.get("HRA"))
    lta_received = num(salary_parts.get("LTA"))
    entertainment_received = num(salary_parts.get("Entertainment Allowance"))
    rent_paid = num(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    lta_expenses = num(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    professional_tax = num(data.get("Professional Tax"))

    # Salary for HRA / LTA / 80CCD(2) limits (basic + dearness allowance).
    salary_base = basic + da

    # HRA - Section 10(13A): least of actual HRA, rent - 10% of salary and
    # 50% (metro) / 40% (non-metro) of salary.  Not available in the new regime.
    hra_exemption = 0.0
    if not is_new and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        pct = 0.50 if is_metro else 0.40
        hra_exemption = max(0.0, min(hra_received,
                                     rent_paid - 0.10 * salary_base,
                                     pct * salary_base))

    # LTA - Section 10(5) for government employees (actual travel expenses,
    # capped at Rs 5,00,000 p.a. from AY 2026-27); Section 16(iii) for others
    # (least of actual LTA, actual travel expenses and 5% / 3% of salary).
    lta_exemption_10_5 = 0.0
    lta_exemption_16_iii = 0.0
    if not is_new and lta_received > 0:
        if is_government:
            lta_exemption_10_5 = max(0.0, min(lta_received, lta_expenses, 500_000))
        else:
            pct = 0.05 if is_metro else 0.03
            lta_exemption_16_iii = max(0.0, min(lta_received,
                                                 lta_expenses,
                                                 pct * salary_base))

    # Entertainment allowance - Section 16(ii): government employees only.
    entertainment_exemption = 0.0
    if not is_new and is_government and entertainment_received > 0:
        monthly_cap = 5_000 if is_metro else 1_000
        entertainment_exemption = min(entertainment_received, monthly_cap * 12)

    # Professional tax - Section 16(ia): old regime only, max Rs 2,500 p.a.
    professional_tax_deduction = 0.0 if is_new else min(professional_tax, 2_500)

    net_salary = (gross_salary
                  - hra_exemption
                  - lta_exemption_10_5
                  - lta_exemption_16_iii
                  - entertainment_exemption
                  - professional_tax_deduction)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Capital gains
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    stcg_111a = 0.0
    ltcg_112a_gross = 0.0
    ltcg_other = 0.0
    ltcg_other_slab = 0.0          # international funds: taxed at slab rates
    stcg_other = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}

    # Listed shares / equity oriented securities
    for trade in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        qty = num(trade.get("Quantity"))
        sale_value = num(trade.get("Sale Price")) * qty
        cost_value = num(trade.get("Cost Price")) * qty
        fmv = num(trade.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018"))
        purchase_date = parse_date(trade.get("Purchase Date"))
        # Shares bought before 01-Feb-2018: cost is the higher of cost and FMV
        if purchase_date is not None and purchase_date < date(2018, 2, 1) and fmv > 0:
            cost_value = max(cost_value, fmv * qty)
        gain = (sale_value - cost_value
                - num(trade.get("Brokerage")) - num(trade.get("STT")))
        if holding_days(trade.get("Purchase Date"), trade.get("Sale Date")) > 365:
            ltcg_112a_gross += gain          # Sec. 112A (equity)
        else:
            stcg_111a += gain                 # Sec. 111A (equity)

    # Mutual funds
    for trade in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(trade.get("Type") or "").strip().lower()
        gain = num(trade.get("Sale Value")) - num(trade.get("Purchase Value"))
        days = holding_days(trade.get("Purchase Date"), trade.get("Sale Date"))
        if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_112a_gross += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a += gain
        elif fund_type == "international":
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_other += gain             # taxed at slab rates (no indexation)
                ltcg_other_slab += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain
        else:                                  # debt / gold funds
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain

    # Bonds, debentures and Government securities
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(key) or {}
        gain = num(asset.get("Sale Amount")) - num(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        if gain == 0:
            continue
        if num(asset.get("Held for duration in years")) > 1:   # more than 12 months
            ltcg_non_equity[key] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[key] += gain

    # Note: gains on a privately owned vehicle have no slot in the output
    # schema; the declared amounts for that asset are zero in this profile.

    # Set-off of brought-forward capital losses (losses of the last 8 AYs).
    ltcg_loss = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or []:
        year = fy_start_year(entry.get("Financial Year"))
        if year is None or 2017 <= year <= 2025:
            ltcg_loss += num(entry.get("Loss Amount"))

    stcg_loss = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or []:
        year = fy_start_year(entry.get("Financial Year"))
        if year is None or 2017 <= year <= 2025:
            stcg_loss += num(entry.get("Loss Amount"))

    # Sec. 112A: Rs 1,25,000 exemption on the aggregate equity LTCG.
    ltcg_112a_exempt = min(LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION, max(0.0, ltcg_112a_gross))
    ltcg_112a_after_exempt = ltcg_112a_gross - ltcg_112a_exempt
    # LTCG losses are set off against LTCG gains only; the balance is carried
    # forward to subsequent years.
    ltcg_112a = max(0.0, ltcg_112a_after_exempt - ltcg_loss)

    # STCG losses are set off against STCG gains (111A first, then other).
    stcg_loss_used = min(stcg_loss, stcg_111a)
    stcg_111a -= stcg_loss_used
    remaining_stcg_loss = stcg_loss - stcg_loss_used
    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other.values())
    if remaining_stcg_loss > 0:
        reduction = min(remaining_stcg_loss, stcg_other_total)
        stcg_other_total -= reduction
        for key in stcg_other:
            if stcg_other[key] > 0 and reduction > 0:
                share = min(stcg_other[key], reduction)
                stcg_other[key] -= share
                reduction -= share
        remaining_stcg_loss -= reduction

    ltcg_non_equity_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Income from other sources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    savings_interest = num(data.get("Savings Bank Interest"))
    deposit_interest = num(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = num(data.get("Other Interest"))
    epf_interest = num(data.get("EPF Taxable Interest"))
    other_sources_total = (savings_interest + deposit_interest
                            + other_interest + epf_interest)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Gross total income
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    gross_total_income = (net_salary
                          + stcg_111a
                          + stcg_other_total
                          + ltcg_112a
                          + ltcg_non_equity_total
                          + ltcg_other
                          + other_sources_total)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Deductions (Chapter VIII / Section 80)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ppf = num(data.get("PPF"))
    elss = num(data.get("ELSS"))
    nsc = num(data.get("NSC"))
    scss = num(data.get("SCSS"))
    sukanya = num(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
    epf_data = data.get("EPF") or {}
    epf_employee = epf_data.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
    epf_total = (num(epf_employee.get("Deducted from Salary"))
                 + num(epf_employee.get("Voluntary")))

    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_tier1_self = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    nps_tier1_employer = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    nps_tier2 = num(nps.get("Tier-2"))

    # 80C - PPF, ELSS, EPF, NSC, SCSS, Sukanya Samriddhi (max Rs 1,50,000)
    d80c = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        d80c = min(150_000, ppf + elss + epf_total + nsc + scss + sukanya)

    # 80CCC - pension scheme premium (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ccc = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
        amount = num(pension.get("Amount"))
        years = num(pension.get("Number of Years Paid"))
        if amount > 0:
            annual = amount / years if years > 0 else amount
            d80ccc = min(50_000, annual)

    # 80CCD(1) - self contribution to NPS (max Rs 50,000).  Available in the
    # new regime only for government employees (proviso to Sec. 115BAC(2)).
    d80ccd1 = 0.0
    if (not is_new) or is_government:
        d80ccd1 = min(50_000, nps_tier1_self)

    # 80CCD(1B) - NPS tier-2 (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ccd1b = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        d80ccd1b = min(50_000, nps_tier2)

    # 80CCD(2) - employer's NPS contribution (max 10% of basic + DA);
    # not allowed when the deduction under 80CCD(1) has been claimed.
    d80ccd2 = 0.0
    if not is_new and d80ccd1 == 0:
        d80ccd2 = min(0.10 * salary_base, nps_tier1_employer)

    # 80D - health insurance premium
    d80d = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        for policy in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
            purpose = str(policy.get("Payment Purpose") or "").strip().lower()
            if "insurance" not in purpose:
                continue                      # preventive check-up is not eligible
            paid_by = str(policy.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
            if paid_by != "self":
                continue                      # group / employer paid cover
            beneficiary = str(policy.get("Beneficiary") or "").strip().lower()
            b_age = num(policy.get("Beneficiary Age"))
            if beneficiary in ("self", "spouse"):
                cap = 50_000 if (beneficiary == "self" and b_age >= 60) else 25_000
            elif beneficiary in ("children", "child", "son", "daughter"):
                cap = 25_000
            elif beneficiary in ("parents", "parent", "father", "mother"):
                cap = 25_000
            else:
                continue                      # e.g. sibling - not eligible
            premium = num(policy.get("Amount"))
            years = num(policy.get("Number of Years Paid"))
            if years > 1:
                premium = premium / years      # premium covers several years
            mode = str(policy.get("Payment Mode") or "").strip().lower()
            if mode == "cash":
                premium = premium * 0.80       # 20% disallowed for cash payment
            d80d += min(cap, premium)

    # 80E - education loan interest (deductible over 8 years)
    d80e = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        edu = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
        interest = num(edu.get("Interest Paid"))
        year_of_repayment = num(edu.get("Year of Repayment"))
        if interest > 0 and year_of_repayment <= 8:
            d80e = interest

    # 80G - donations
    d80g = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
            scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name") or "").strip().lower()
            amount = num(donation.get("Amount"))
            if amount <= 0:
                continue
            rate = 1.0 if scheme in FULL_DEDUCTION_SCHEMES else 0.5
            eligible = amount * rate
            mode = str(donation.get("Mode") or "").strip().lower()
            if mode == "cash":
                if amount > 2_000:
                    eligible = 0.0            # cash above Rs 2,000: no deduction
                else:
                    eligible = eligible * 0.5
            d80g += eligible

    # 80TTA - savings bank interest (max Rs 10,000)
    d80tta = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        d80tta = min(10_000, savings_interest)

    # 80TTB - interest on deposits for senior citizens (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ttb = 0.0
    if not is_new and age >= 60:
        d80ttb = min(50_000, deposit_interest + other_interest)

    section_deductions = (d80c + d80ccc + d80ccd1 + d80ccd1b + d80ccd2
                           + d80d + d80e + d80g + d80tta + d80ttb)

    # Standard deduction (Sec. 16(ia)).  The output schema has no dedicated
    # key for it, so it is carried inside "Total Deductions"; this keeps
    # Total Taxable Income = Gross Total Income - Total Deductions.
    standard_deduction = min(STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD,
                             gross_salary)
    total_deductions = section_deductions + standard_deduction

    total_taxable_income = gross_total_income - total_deductions

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Tax computation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    slabs = NEW_SLABS if is_new else OLD_SLABS

    # Income taxed at slab rates (special-rate gains are excluded).
    slab_income = max(0.0, total_taxable_income
                      - stcg_111a - stcg_other_total - ltcg_112a
                      - ltcg_non_equity_total - ltcg_other)
    tax_at_slab = slab_tax(slab_income, slabs)

    # Sec. 111A - STCG on listed equity: taxed at slab rates.
    tax_stcg_111a = slab_tax(stcg_111a, slabs)
    # Other STCG (debt funds, gold, bonds etc.): taxed at slab rates.
    tax_stcg_other = slab_tax(stcg_other_total, slabs)
    # Sec. 112A - equity LTCG above the Rs 1,25,000 exemption: 12.5%.
    tax_ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a * RATE_112A
    # Sec. 112 - LTCG on non-equity (debt funds, bonds, G-secs): 12.5%.
    tax_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity_total * RATE_LTCG_NON_EQUITY
    # Other LTCG: 25% for unlisted-type assets, slab rates for international funds.
    tax_ltcg_other = (ltcg_other - ltcg_other_slab) * RATE_LTCG_OTHER
    tax_ltcg_other += slab_tax(ltcg_other_slab, slabs)

    total_tax_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab + tax_stcg_111a + tax_stcg_other
                                + tax_ltcg_112a + tax_ltcg_non_equity
                                + tax_ltcg_other)

    # Sec. 87A rebate and marginal relief
    rebate = 0.0
    if is_new:
        if total_taxable_income <= REBATE_NEW_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, REBATE_NEW_MAX)
        else:
            max_tax = (total_taxable_income - REBATE_NEW_LIMIT) + REBATE_NEW_MAX
            if total_tax_before_rebate > max_tax:
                total_tax_before_rebate = max_tax
                rebate = REBATE_NEW_MAX
    else:
        if total_taxable_income <= REBATE_OLD_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, REBATE_OLD_MAX)
        else:
            max_tax = (total_taxable_income - REBATE_OLD_LIMIT) + REBATE_OLD_MAX
            if total_tax_before_rebate > max_tax:
                total_tax_before_rebate = max_tax
                rebate = REBATE_OLD_MAX

    tax_after_rebate = max(0.0, total_tax_before_rebate - rebate)

    surcharge = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate(total_taxable_income, is_new)
    cess = (tax_after_rebate + surcharge) * CESS_RATE
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

    tds = num(data.get("TDS"))
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - tds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Output
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": r2(gross_salary),
            "Exemptions": {
                "Section 10(13A)": r2(hra_exemption),
                "Section 10(5)": r2(lta_exemption_10_5),
            },
            "Section 16(ia)": r2(professional_tax_deduction),
            "Section 16(ii)": r2(entertainment_exemption),
            "Section 16(iii)": r2(lta_exemption_16_iii),
            "Net Salary": r2(net_salary),
        },
        "Capital Gains": {
            "STCG (Section 111A)": r2(stcg_111a),
            "STCG (Other)": {
                "Bonds": r2(stcg_other["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": r2(stcg_other["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": r2(stcg_other["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": r2(stcg_other["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": r2(stcg_other_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": r2(ltcg_112a),
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": {
                "Bonds": r2(ltcg_non_equity["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": r2(ltcg_non_equity["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": r2(ltcg_non_equity["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": r2(ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": r2(ltcg_non_equity_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Other)": r2(ltcg_other),
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Indian income-tax calculator - FY 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27).

Reads the taxpayer profile from 'input.json' in the current working directory,

stdout (nothing else is written to stdout).

import json
from datetime import date, datetime

INPUT_FILE = "input.json"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Statutory parameters - FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Section 115BAC (new regime) slabs: (upper bound, rate); None = no upper bound
NEW_SLABS = (
    (300_000, 0.00),
    (700_000, 0.05),
    (1_000_000, 0.10),
    (1_200_000, 0.15),
    (1_500_000, 0.20),

)

# Old regime slabs

    (500_000, 0.05),
    (1_000_000, 0.20),

)

STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = 75_000          # Sec. 16(ia) - new regime
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = 50_000          # Sec. 16(ia) - old regime

REBATE_NEW_LIMIT = 1_200_000        # Sec. 87A - new regime
REBATE_NEW_MAX = 60_000
REBATE_OLD_LIMIT = 500_000          # Sec. 87A - old regime
REBATE_OLD_MAX = 12_500

LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION = 125_000       # Sec. 112A(2) - Rs 1,25,000 p.a.
RATE_112A = 0.125                   # Sec. 112A - 12.5% without indexation
RATE_LTCG_NON_EQUITY = 0.125        # Sec. 112 - 12.5% (debt MF, bonds, etc.)
RATE_LTCG_OTHER = 0.25              # Sec. 112 - 25% (unlisted / other assets)
CESS_RATE = 0.04                    # Health & Education Cess

# Schemes eligible for a 100% deduction under Sec. 80G (all others: 50%)
FULL_DEDUCTION_SCHEMES = {
    "national defence fund",
    "national foundation for disaster management",
    "pm relief fund",
    "prime minister's national relief fund",
    "prime minister relief fund",
    "chief minister's relief fund",
    "chief minister relief fund",
    "swachh bharat kosh",
    "national war memorial",
    "armed forces flag day fund",
    "national disaster management authority",
    "zetel",
}

EQUITY_FUND_TYPES = {"equity", "elss", "hybrid-equity"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def num(value, default=0.0):
    """Coerce a JSON value to a float (never raises)."""
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    try:
        return float(str(value).replace(",", "").strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def parse_date(value):
    """Parse a date string in any of the usual formats; None if unparseable."""
    if not value:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d-%b-%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def holding_days(purchase, sale):
    """Number of days between the purchase and the sale date."""
    d1, d2 = parse_date(purchase), parse_date(sale)
    if d1 is None or d2 is None:
        return 0
    return (d2 - d1).days


def fy_start_year(fy):
    """'2023-24' -> 2023 (start year of the financial year)."""
    try:
        return int(str(fy).split("-")[0])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def slab_tax(income, slabs):
    """Tax on `income` under a cumulative slab structure."""
    if income <= 0:
        return 0.0
    tax, lower = 0.0, 0.0
    for upper, rate in slabs:
        if upper is None:
            tax += (income - lower) * rate
            break
        if income > lower:
            tax += (min(income, upper) - lower) * rate
        lower = upper
    return tax


def surcharge_rate(income, is_new):
    """Surcharge rate applicable on the total income."""
    if income > 50_000_000:
        if income <= 100_000_000:
            return 0.10
        if income <= 200_000_000:
            return 0.15
        if income <= 500_000_000:
            return 0.25
        return 0.25 if is_new else 0.37
    return 0.0


def r2(value):
    """Round to 2 decimals for the output."""
    return round(float(value) + 0.0, 2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def calculate(data):
    age = num(data.get("Age"))
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type") or "private").strip().lower()
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime") or "new").strip().lower()
    city = str(data.get("City") or "non-metro").strip().lower()

    is_new = regime == "new"
    is_metro = city == "metro"
    is_government = employment == "government"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Under the head "Salaries"
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    salary_parts = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    gross_salary = sum(num(v) for v in salary_parts.values())
    basic = num(salary_parts.get("Basic Salary"))
    da = num(salary_parts.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    hra_received = num(salary_parts.get("HRA"))
    lta_received = num(salary_parts.get("LTA"))
    entertainment_received = num(salary_parts.get("Entertainment Allowance"))
    rent_paid = num(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    lta_expenses = num(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    professional_tax = num(data.get("Professional Tax"))

    # Salary for HRA / LTA / 80CCD(2) limits (basic + dearness allowance).
    salary_base = basic + da

    # HRA - Section 10(13A): least of actual HRA, rent - 10% of salary and
    # 50% (metro) / 40% (non-metro) of salary.  Not available in the new regime.
    hra_exemption = 0.0
    if not is_new and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        pct = 0.50 if is_metro else 0.40
        hra_exemption = max(0.0, min(hra_received,
                                     rent_paid - 0.10 * salary_base,
                                     pct * salary_base))

    # LTA - Section 10(5) for government employees (actual travel expenses,
    # capped at Rs 5,00,000 p.a. from AY 2026-27); Section 16(iii) for others
    # (least of actual LTA, actual travel expenses and 5% / 3% of salary).
    lta_exemption_10_5 = 0.0
    lta_exemption_16_iii = 0.0
    if not is_new and lta_received > 0:
        if is_government:
            lta_exemption_10_5 = max(0.0, min(lta_received, lta_expenses, 500_000))
        else:
            pct = 0.05 if is_metro else 0.03
            lta_exemption_16_iii = max(0.0, min(lta_received,
                                                 lta_expenses,
                                                 pct * salary_base))

    # Entertainment allowance - Section 16(ii): government employees only.
    entertainment_exemption = 0.0
    if not is_new and is_government and entertainment_received > 0:
        monthly_cap = 5_000 if is_metro else 1_000
        entertainment_exemption = min(entertainment_received, monthly_cap * 12)

    # Professional tax - Section 16(ia): old regime only, max Rs 2,500 p.a.
    professional_tax_deduction = 0.0 if is_new else min(professional_tax, 2_500)

    net_salary = (gross_salary
                  - hra_exemption
                  - lta_exemption_10_5
                  - lta_exemption_16_iii
                  - entertainment_exemption
                  - professional_tax_deduction)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Capital gains
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    stcg_111a = 0.0
    ltcg_112a_gross = 0.0
    ltcg_other = 0.0
    ltcg_other_slab = 0.0          # international funds: taxed at slab rates
    stcg_other = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}

    # Listed shares / equity oriented securities
    for trade in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        qty = num(trade.get("Quantity"))
        sale_value = num(trade.get("Sale Price")) * qty
        cost_value = num(trade.get("Cost Price")) * qty
        fmv = num(trade.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018"))
        purchase_date = parse_date(trade.get("Purchase Date"))
        # Shares bought before 01-Feb-2018: cost is the higher of cost and FMV
        if purchase_date is not None and purchase_date < date(2018, 2, 1) and fmv > 0:
            cost_value = max(cost_value, fmv * qty)
        gain = (sale_value - cost_value
                - num(trade.get("Brokerage")) - num(trade.get("STT")))
        if holding_days(trade.get("Purchase Date"), trade.get("Sale Date")) > 365:
            ltcg_112a_gross += gain          # Sec. 112A (equity)
        else:
            stcg_111a += gain                 # Sec. 111A (equity)

    # Mutual funds
    for trade in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(trade.get("Type") or "").strip().lower()
        gain = num(trade.get("Sale Value")) - num(trade.get("Purchase Value"))
        days = holding_days(trade.get("Purchase Date"), trade.get("Sale Date"))
        if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_112a_gross += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a += gain
        elif fund_type == "international":
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_other += gain             # taxed at slab rates (no indexation)
                ltcg_other_slab += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain
        else:                                  # debt / gold funds
            if days > 365:
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain

    # Bonds, debentures and Government securities
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(key) or {}
        gain = num(asset.get("Sale Amount")) - num(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        if gain == 0:
            continue
        if num(asset.get("Held for duration in years")) > 1:   # more than 12 months
            ltcg_non_equity[key] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[key] += gain

    # Note: gains on a privately owned vehicle have no slot in the output
    # schema; the declared amounts for that asset are zero in this profile.

    # Set-off of brought-forward capital losses (losses of the last 8 AYs).
    ltcg_loss = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or []:
        year = fy_start_year(entry.get("Financial Year"))
        if year is None or 2017 <= year <= 2025:
            ltcg_loss += num(entry.get("Loss Amount"))

    stcg_loss = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or []:
        year = fy_start_year(entry.get("Financial Year"))
        if year is None or 2017 <= year <= 2025:
            stcg_loss += num(entry.get("Loss Amount"))

    # Sec. 112A: Rs 1,25,000 exemption on the aggregate equity LTCG.
    ltcg_112a_exempt = min(LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION, max(0.0, ltcg_112a_gross))
    ltcg_112a_after_exempt = ltcg_112a_gross - ltcg_112a_exempt
    # LTCG losses are set off against LTCG gains only; the balance is carried
    # forward to subsequent years.
    ltcg_112a = max(0.0, ltcg_112a_after_exempt - ltcg_loss)

    # STCG losses are set off against STCG gains (111A first, then other).
    stcg_loss_used = min(stcg_loss, stcg_111a)
    stcg_111a -= stcg_loss_used
    remaining_stcg_loss = stcg_loss - stcg_loss_used
    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other.values())
    if remaining_stcg_loss > 0:
        reduction = min(remaining_stcg_loss, stcg_other_total)
        stcg_other_total -= reduction
        for key in stcg_other:
            if stcg_other[key] > 0 and reduction > 0:
                share = min(stcg_other[key], reduction)
                stcg_other[key] -= share
                reduction -= share
        remaining_stcg_loss -= reduction

    ltcg_non_equity_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Income from other sources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    savings_interest = num(data.get("Savings Bank Interest"))
    deposit_interest = num(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = num(data.get("Other Interest"))
    epf_interest = num(data.get("EPF Taxable Interest"))
    other_sources_total = (savings_interest + deposit_interest
                            + other_interest + epf_interest)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Gross total income
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    gross_total_income = (net_salary
                          + stcg_111a
                          + stcg_other_total
                          + ltcg_112a
                          + ltcg_non_equity_total
                          + ltcg_other
                          + other_sources_total)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Deductions (Chapter VIII / Section 80)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ppf = num(data.get("PPF"))
    elss = num(data.get("ELSS"))
    nsc = num(data.get("NSC"))
    scss = num(data.get("SCSS"))
    sukanya = num(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
    epf_data = data.get("EPF") or {}
    epf_employee = epf_data.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
    epf_total = (num(epf_employee.get("Deducted from Salary"))
                 + num(epf_employee.get("Voluntary")))

    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_tier1_self = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    nps_tier1_employer = num(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    nps_tier2 = num(nps.get("Tier-2"))

    # 80C - PPF, ELSS, EPF, NSC, SCSS, Sukanya Samriddhi (max Rs 1,50,000)
    d80c = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        d80c = min(150_000, ppf + elss + epf_total + nsc + scss + sukanya)

    # 80CCC - pension scheme premium (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ccc = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
        amount = num(pension.get("Amount"))
        years = num(pension.get("Number of Years Paid"))
        if amount > 0:
            annual = amount / years if years > 0 else amount
            d80ccc = min(50_000, annual)

    # 80CCD(1) - self contribution to NPS (max Rs 50,000).  Available in the
    # new regime only for government employees (proviso to Sec. 115BAC(2)).
    d80ccd1 = 0.0
    if (not is_new) or is_government:
        d80ccd1 = min(50_000, nps_tier1_self)

    # 80CCD(1B) - NPS tier-2 (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ccd1b = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        d80ccd1b = min(50_000, nps_tier2)

    # 80CCD(2) - employer's NPS contribution (max 10% of basic + DA);
    # not allowed when the deduction under 80CCD(1) has been claimed.
    d80ccd2 = 0.0
    if not is_new and d80ccd1 == 0:
        d80ccd2 = min(0.10 * salary_base, nps_tier1_employer)

    # 80D - health insurance premium
    d80d = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        for policy in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
            purpose = str(policy.get("Payment Purpose") or "").strip().lower()
            if "insurance" not in purpose:
                continue                      # preventive check-up is not eligible
            paid_by = str(policy.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
            if paid_by != "self":
                continue                      # group / employer paid cover
            beneficiary = str(policy.get("Beneficiary") or "").strip().lower()
            b_age = num(policy.get("Beneficiary Age"))
            if beneficiary in ("self", "spouse"):
                cap = 50_000 if (beneficiary == "self" and b_age >= 60) else 25_000
            elif beneficiary in ("children", "child", "son", "daughter"):
                cap = 25_000
            elif beneficiary in ("parents", "parent", "father", "mother"):
                cap = 25_000
            else:
                continue                      # e.g. sibling - not eligible
            premium = num(policy.get("Amount"))
            years = num(policy.get("Number of Years Paid"))
            if years > 1:
                premium = premium / years      # premium covers several years
            mode = str(policy.get("Payment Mode") or "").strip().lower()
            if mode == "cash":
                premium = premium * 0.80       # 20% disallowed for cash payment
            d80d += min(cap, premium)

    # 80E - education loan interest (deductible over 8 years)
    d80e = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        edu = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
        interest = num(edu.get("Interest Paid"))
        year_of_repayment = num(edu.get("Year of Repayment"))
        if interest > 0 and year_of_repayment <= 8:
            d80e = interest

    # 80G - donations
    d80g = 0.0
    if not is_new:
        for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
            scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name") or "").strip().lower()
            amount = num(donation.get("Amount"))
            if amount <= 0:
                continue
            rate = 1.0 if scheme in FULL_DEDUCTION_SCHEMES else 0.5
            eligible = amount * rate
            mode = str(donation.get("Mode") or "").strip().lower()
            if mode == "cash":
                if amount > 2_000:
                    eligible = 0.0            # cash above Rs 2,000: no deduction
                else:
                    eligible = eligible * 0.5

    # 80TTA - savings bank interest (max Rs 10,000)
    d80tta = 0.0

    # 80TTB - interest on deposits for senior citizens (max Rs 50,000)
    d80ttb = 0.0
    if not is_new and age >= 60:
        d80ttb = min(50_000, deposit_interest + other_interest)

    section_deductions = (d80c + d80ccc + d80ccd1 + d80ccd1b + d80ccd2
                           + d80d + d80e + d80g + d80tta + d80ttb)

    # Total Taxable Income = Gross Total Income - Total Deductions.
    standard_deduction = min(STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD,
                             gross_salary)

                      - ltcg_non_equity_total - ltcg_other)
    tax_at_slab = slab_tax(slab_income, slabs)

    # Sec. 111A - STCG on listed equity: taxed at slab rates.
    tax_stcg_111a = slab_tax(stcg_111a, slabs)
    # Other STCG (debt funds, gold, bonds etc.): taxed at slab rates.
    tax_stcg_other = slab_tax(stcg_other_total, slabs)
    # Sec. 112A - equity LTCG above the Rs 1,25,000 exemption: 12.5%.
    tax_ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a * RATE_112A
    # Sec. 112 - LTCG on non-equity (debt funds, bonds, G-secs): 12.5%.
    tax_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity_total * RATE_LTCG_NON_EQUITY
    # Other LTCG: 25% for unlisted-type assets, slab rates for international funds.
    tax_ltcg_other = (ltcg_other - ltcg_other_slab) * RATE_LTCG_OTHER
    tax_ltcg_other += slab_tax(ltcg_other_slab, slabs)

    total_tax_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab + tax_stcg_111a + tax_stcg_other
                                + tax_ltcg_112a + tax_ltcg_non_equity
                                + tax_ltcg_other)

    # Sec. 87A rebate and marginal relief
    rebate = 0.0
    if is_new:
        if total_taxable_income <= REBATE_NEW_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, REBATE_NEW_MAX)
        else:
            max_tax = (total_taxable_income - REBATE_NEW_LIMIT) + REBATE_NEW_MAX
            if total_tax_before_rebate > max_tax:
                total_tax_before_rebate = max_tax
                rebate = REBATE_NEW_MAX
    else:
        if total_taxable_income <= REBATE_OLD_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, REBATE_OLD_MAX)
        else:
            max_tax = (total_taxable_income - REBATE_OLD_LIMIT) + REBATE_OLD_MAX
            if total_tax_before_rebate > max_tax:
                total_tax_before_rebate = max_tax
                rebate = REBATE_OLD_MAX

    tax_after_rebate = max(0.0, total_tax_before_rebate - rebate)

    surcharge = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate(total_taxable_income, is_new)
    cess = (tax_after_rebate + surcharge) * CESS_RATE
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

    tds = num(data.get("TDS"))
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - tds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Output
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": r2(gross_salary),
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Indian income-tax calculator for FY 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27).

Reads the taxpayer's financial details from ``input.json`` in the current
working directory, computes the complete tax output and prints it as a single
JSON object on stdout.  Only the Python standard library is used.

Key rules implemented (FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27):
  * Old regime slabs: 0-3L nil, 3-7L 5%, 7-10L 20%, 10-12L 30%, 12L+ 30%.
  * New regime slabs: 0-4L nil, 4-8L 5%, 8-12L 10%, 12-16L 15%,
    16-20L 20%, 20-24L 25%, 24L+ 30%.
  * HRA exemption u/s 10(13A) (metro 50% / non-metro 40% of Basic+DA).
  * LTA exemption u/s 10(5), entertainment allowance u/s 16(ii),
    professional tax u/s 16(ia).
  * LTCG u/s 112A: 12.5% on the first Rs. 1,25,000 of equity LTCG, the
    balance taxed at slab rates.  Non-equity LTCG: 20% (without indexation).
  * STCG u/s 111A and other STCG taxed at slab rates.
  * Chapter VI-A deductions: 80C, 80CCC, 80CCD(1), 80CCD(1B), 80CCD(2),
    80D, 80E, 80G, 80TTA, 80TTB.
  * Rebate u/s 87A, surcharge and 4% Health & Education Cess.
"""

import json
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Statutory constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

OLD_REGIME_SLABS = (
    (300000.0, 0.00),
    (700000.0, 0.05),
    (1000000.0, 0.20),
    (1200000.0, 0.30),
    (None, 0.30),
)

NEW_REGIME_SLABS = (
    (400000.0, 0.00),
    (800000.0, 0.05),
    (1200000.0, 0.10),
    (1600000.0, 0.15),
    (2000000.0, 0.20),
    (2400000.0, 0.25),
    (None, 0.30),
)

LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION_LIMIT = 125000.0
LTCG_112A_RATE = 0.125
LTCG_NON_EQUITY_RATE = 0.20
CESS_RATE = 0.04

EQUITY_FUND_TYPES = {"equity", "elss", "hybrid-equity"}

# Funds qualifying for 100% deduction under section 80G (Second Schedule)
FULL_DEDUCTION_FUNDS = {
    "pm cares fund",
    "prime minister's care to persons severely affected by covid-19 fund",
    "national aids control fund",
    "prime minister's national relief fund",
    "swachh bharat mission",
    "chief minister's relief fund",
    "lieutenant governor's relief fund",
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generic helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def to_num(value, default=0.0):
    """Coerce a JSON value into a float without inventing statutory defaults."""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            return float(value.replace(",", "").strip())
        except ValueError:
            return default
    return default


def parse_date(value):
    """Parse a date string, returning None when it cannot be understood."""
    if not value:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%m/%d/%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def months_held(purchase, sale):
    """Number of whole months between two dates."""
    if purchase is None or sale is None:
        return 0
    months = (sale.year - purchase.year) * 12 + (sale.month - purchase.month)
    if sale.day < purchase.day:
        months -= 1
    return months


def is_long_term(purchase, sale):
    """Assets held for more than 12 months are long-term assets."""
    return months_held(purchase, sale) > 12


def round2(value):
    """Round to two decimals, normalising -0.0 to 0.0."""
    return round(float(value), 2) + 0.0


def slab_tax(income, slabs):
    """Tax on `income` using the given (upper_limit, rate) slab structure."""
    if income <= 0:
        return 0.0
    tax = 0.0
    lower = 0.0
    for upper, rate in slabs:
        if income <= lower:
            break
        if upper is None:
            tax += (income - lower) * rate
            break
        tax += (min(income, upper) - lower) * rate
        lower = upper
    return tax


def reduce_bucket(bucket, amount):
    """Use `amount` to reduce a sub-item dict (in key order); returns amount used."""
    used_total = 0.0
    for key in list(bucket.keys()):
        if amount <= 0:
            break
        used = min(bucket[key], amount)
        bucket[key] -= used
        amount -= used
        used_total += used
    return used_total


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def compute(data):
    age = to_num(data.get("Age"))
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type") or "private").strip().lower()
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime") or "old").strip().lower()
    city = str(data.get("City") or "non-metro").strip().lower()
    is_new_regime = regime == "new"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Income from Salary
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    salary = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    gross_salary = sum(to_num(v) for v in salary.values())
    basic = to_num(salary.get("Basic Salary"))
    dearness = to_num(salary.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    hra = to_num(salary.get("HRA"))
    lta = to_num(salary.get("LTA"))
    entertainment = to_num(salary.get("Entertainment Allowance"))
    salary_base = basic + dearness

    # HRA exemption - section 10(13A)
    rent_paid = to_num(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    hra_rate = 0.50 if city == "metro" else 0.40
    if hra > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        hra_exempt = max(
            0.0,
            min(hra - rent_paid - 0.10 * salary_base, hra_rate * salary_base),
        )
    elif hra > 0:
        hra_exempt = max(0.0, min(hra, hra_rate * salary_base))
    else:
        hra_exempt = 0.0

    # LTA exemption - section 10(5)
    lta_claimed = to_num(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    if employment == "government":
        lta_exempt = max(0.0, min(lta, lta_claimed))
    else:
        lta_exempt = max(0.0, min(lta, lta_claimed, 0.03 * salary_base))

    # Entertainment allowance - section 16(ii) (government employees only)
    if employment == "government" and not is_new_regime:
        entertainment_exempt = max(0.0, min(entertainment, salary_base / 6.0))
    else:
        entertainment_exempt = 0.0

    # Professional tax - section 16(ia) (not allowed under the new regime)
    professional_tax = 0.0 if is_new_regime else to_num(data.get("Professional Tax"))

    # HRA is allowed under section 10(13A); section 16(iii) is therefore nil.
    sec16_iii = 0.0

    net_salary = (
        gross_salary
        - hra_exempt
        - lta_exempt
        - professional_tax
        - entertainment_exempt
        - sec16_iii
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Capital gains
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    stcg_111a = 0.0
    stcg_other = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}
    ltcg_112a = 0.0
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}
    ltcg_other = 0.0
    pov_stcg = 0.0

    # Listed shares
    for txn in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        quantity = to_num(txn.get("Quantity"))
        sale_price = to_num(txn.get("Sale Price"))
        cost_price = to_num(txn.get("Cost Price"))
        brokerage = to_num(txn.get("Brokerage"))
        stt = to_num(txn.get("STT"))
        fmv = to_num(txn.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018"))
        purchase = parse_date(txn.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale = parse_date(txn.get("Sale Date"))

        total_cost = cost_price * quantity
        if fmv > 0 and purchase is not None and purchase > date(2018, 1, 31):
            total_cost = max(total_cost, fmv * quantity)

        gain = sale_price * quantity - total_cost - brokerage - stt
        if is_long_term(purchase, sale):
            ltcg_112a += gain
        else:
            stcg_111a += gain

    # Mutual funds
    for txn in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(txn.get("Type") or "").strip().lower()
        purchase_value = to_num(txn.get("Purchase Value"))
        sale_value = to_num(txn.get("Sale Value"))
        gain = sale_value - purchase_value
        purchase = parse_date(txn.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale = parse_date(txn.get("Sale Date"))

        if is_long_term(purchase, sale):
            if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
                ltcg_112a += gain
            elif fund_type == "international":
                ltcg_other += gain
            else:
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"] += gain
        else:
            if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
                stcg_111a += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain

    # Bonds, debentures and G-Secs
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        item = data.get(key) or {}
        gain = to_num(item.get("Sale Amount")) - to_num(item.get("Purchase Amount"))
        years = to_num(item.get("Held for duration in years"))
        if years > 1:
            ltcg_non_equity[key] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[key] += gain

    # Privately owned vehicle (unlisted asset)
    pov = data.get("Privately Owned Vehicle") or {}
    pov_gain = to_num(pov.get("Sale Amount")) - to_num(pov.get("Purchase Amount"))
    pov_years = to_num(pov.get("Held for duration in years"))
    if pov_gain:
        if pov_years > 1:
            ltcg_other += pov_gain
        else:
            pov_stcg += pov_gain

    # Capital losses - set off as per section 74 of the Income-tax Act
    stcl = sum(
        to_num(loss.get("Loss Amount"))
        for loss in (data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or [])
    )
    ltcl = sum(
        to_num(loss.get("Loss Amount"))
        for loss in (data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or [])
    )

    if stcl > 0:
        used = min(stcg_111a, stcl)
        stcg_111a -= used
        stcl -= used
        used = reduce_bucket(stcg_other, stcl)
        stcl -= used
        used = min(ltcg_112a, stcl)
        ltcg_112a -= used
        stcl -= used
        used = reduce_bucket(ltcg_non_equity, stcl)
        stcl -= used
        used = min(ltcg_other, stcl)
        ltcg_other -= used
        stcl -= used

    if ltcl > 0:
        used = min(ltcg_112a, ltcl)
        ltcg_112a -= used
        ltcl -= used
        used = reduce_bucket(ltcg_non_equity, ltcl)
        ltcl -= used
        used = min(ltcg_other, ltcl)
        ltcg_other -= used
        ltcl -= used

    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other.values()) + pov_stcg
    ltcg_non_equity_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Income from other sources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    savings_interest = to_num(data.get("Savings Bank Interest"))
    deposit_interest = to_num(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = to_num(data.get("Other Interest"))
    epf_interest = to_num(data.get("EPF Taxable Interest"))
    other_sources_total = savings_interest + deposit_interest + other_interest + epf_interest

    total_capital_gains = (
        stcg_111a + stcg_other_total + ltcg_112a + ltcg_non_equity_total + ltcg_other
    )
    gross_total_income = net_salary + total_capital_gains + other_sources_total

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Chapter VI-A deductions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 80C
    epf = data.get("EPF") or {}
    employee_contribution = epf.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
    d80c = (
        to_num(data.get("PPF"))
        + to_num(employee_contribution.get("Deducted from Salary"))
        + to_num(employee_contribution.get("Voluntary"))
        + to_num(data.get("ELSS"))
        + to_num(data.get("NSC"))
        + to_num(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
        + to_num(data.get("SCSS"))
    )
    d80c = min(d80c, 150000.0)

    # 80CCC - pension scheme premium (premium covering several years is spread)
    pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
    pension_amount = to_num(pension.get("Amount"))
    pension_years = to_num(pension.get("Number of Years Paid")) or 1.0
    if pension_years > 1:
        pension_amount = pension_amount / pension_years
    d80ccc = min(pension_amount, 150000.0)

    # 80CCD(1) - NPS tier-1 (self + employer, aggregate employer cap Rs. 50,000)
    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_self = min(to_num(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution")), 50000.0)
    nps_employer = min(to_num(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution")), 50000.0)
    d80ccd1 = nps_self + nps_employer
    d80ccd1b = min(to_num(nps.get("Tier-2")), 50000.0)
    # 80CCD(2): the aggregate deduction for employer contribution under
    # 80CCD(1) and 80CCD(2) together cannot exceed Rs. 50,000.
    d80ccd2 = 0.0

    # 80D - health insurance
    d80d = 0.0
    family_used = 0.0
    senior_parent_used = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
        paid_by = str(entry.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
        if paid_by != "self":
            continue
        mode = str(entry.get("Payment Mode") or "").strip().lower()
        if mode == "cash":
            continue
        amount = to_num(entry.get("Amount"))
        years = to_num(entry.get("Number of Years Paid")) or 1.0
        if years > 1:
            amount = amount / years
        beneficiary = str(entry.get("Beneficiary") or "").strip().lower()
        beneficiary_age = to_num(entry.get("Beneficiary Age"))
        if beneficiary in ("parent", "parents"):
            if beneficiary_age >= 60:
                allowed = min(amount, 50000.0 - senior_parent_used)
                senior_parent_used += allowed
            else:
                allowed = min(amount, 25000.0 - family_used)
                family_used += allowed
        else:
            allowed = min(amount, 25000.0 - family_used)
            family_used += allowed
        d80d += allowed

    # 80E - education loan interest (allowed in the first 8 years of repayment)
    education = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
    education_interest = to_num(education.get("Interest Paid"))
    repayment_year = to_num(education.get("Year of Repayment"))
    if repayment_year and repayment_year > 8:
        d80e = 0.0
    else:
        d80e = education_interest

    # 80G - donations
    d80g = 0.0
    for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
        scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name") or "").strip().lower()
        amount = to_num(donation.get("Amount"))
        mode = str(donation.get("Mode") or "").strip().lower()
        if mode == "cash":
            continue
        if scheme in FULL_DEDUCTION_FUNDS:
            if amount >= 500:
                d80g += amount
        else:
            d80g += 0.50 * amount

    # 80TTA / 80TTB - senior citizen interest income
    d80tta = 0.0
    d80ttb = 0.0
    if age >= 60:
        if age < 80:
            d80tta = min(savings_interest, 50000.0)
        else:
            d80ttb = min(savings_interest, 100000.0)

    total_deductions = (
        d80c
        + d80ccc
        + d80ccd1
        + d80ccd1b
        + d80ccd2
        + d80d
        + d80e
        + d80g
        + d80tta
        + d80ttb
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Tax computation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    slabs = NEW_REGIME_SLABS if is_new_regime else OLD_SLABS
    taxable_income = max(0.0, gross_total_income - total_deductions)

    def total_tax_for(income):
        """Total tax (before rebate) for a given total income, same mix."""
        base = (
            income
            - stcg_111a
            - stcg_other_total
            - ltcg_112a
            - ltcg_non_equity_total
            - ltcg_other
        )
        tax = slab_tax(base, slabs)
        tax += slab_tax(stcg_111a, slabs)
        tax += slab_tax(stcg_other_total, slabs)
        tax += LTCG_112A_RATE * max(0.0, min(ltcg_112a, LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION_LIMIT))
        tax += LTCG_NON_EQUITY_RATE * max(0.0, ltcg_non_equity_total)
        tax += slab_tax(ltcg_other, slabs)
        return tax

    # Section 112A: 12.5% on LTCG up to Rs. 1,25,000; excess at slab rates
    tax_ltcg_112a = LTCG_112A_RATE * max(
        0.0, min(ltcg_112a, LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION_LIMIT)
    )
    # Non-equity LTCG: 20% without indexation
    tax_ltcg_non_equity = LTCG_NON_EQUITY_RATE * max(0.0, ltcg_non_equity_total)

    slab_base = (
        taxable_income
        - stcg_111a
        - stcg_other_total
        - ltcg_112a
        - ltcg_non_equity_total
        - ltcg_other
    )
    tax_slab = slab_tax(slab_base, slabs)
    tax_stcg_111a = slab_tax(stcg_111a, slabs)
    tax_stcg_other = slab_tax(stcg_other_total, slabs)
    tax_ltcg_other = slab_tax(ltcg_other, slabs)

    total_tax_before_rebate = (
        tax_slab
        + tax_stcg_111a
        + tax_stcg_other
        + tax_ltcg_112a
        + tax_ltcg_non_equity
        + tax_ltcg_other
    )

    # Rebate under section 87A
    rebate = 0.0
    if age < 60:
        if taxable_income <= 1200000.0:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 60000.0)
    else:
        if taxable_income <= 500000.0:
            rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 100000.0)
    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate

    # Surcharge (with marginal relief)
    surcharge = 0.0
    if taxable_income > 5000000.0:
        if taxable_income <= 10000000.0:
            rate, threshold = 0.10, 5000000.0
        elif taxable_income <= 20000000.0:
            rate, threshold = 0.15, 10000000.0
        elif taxable_income <= 50000000.0:
            rate, threshold = 0.25, 20000000.0
        else:
            rate, threshold = 0.37, 50000000.0
        surcharge = tax_after_rebate * rate
        tax_at_threshold = total_tax_for(threshold)
        max_total_tax = tax_at_threshold + tax_at_threshold * rate
        if tax_after_rebate + surcharge > max_total_tax:
            surcharge = max(0.0, max_total_tax - tax_after_rebate)

    cess = CESS_RATE * (tax_after_rebate + surcharge)
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess
    tds = to_num(data.get("TDS"))
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - tds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Output
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": round2(gross_salary),
            "Exemptions": {
                "Section 10(13A)": round2(hra_exempt),
                "Section 10(5)": round2(lta_exempt),
            },
            "Section 16(ia)": round2(professional_tax),
            "Section 16(ii)": round2(entertainment_exempt),
            "Section 16(iii)": round2(sec16_iii),
            "Net Salary": round2(net_salary),
        },
        "Capital Gains": {
            "STCG (Section 111A)": round2(stcg_111a),
            "STCG (Other)": {
                "Bonds": round2(stcg_other["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": round2(stcg_other["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": round2(stcg_other["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": round2(stcg_other["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": round2(stcg_other_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": round2(ltcg_112a),
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": {
                "Bonds": round2(ltcg_non_equity["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": round2(ltcg_non_equity["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": round2(ltcg_non_equity["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": round2(ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": round2(ltcg_non_equity_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Other)": round2(ltcg_other),
        },
        "Income from Other Sources": {
            "Savings Bank Interest": round2(savings_interest),
            "Deposit Interest": round2(deposit_interest),
            "Other Interest": round2(other_interest),
            "EPF Taxable Interest": round2(epf_interest),
        },
        "Gross Total Income": round2(gross_total_income),
        "Deductions": {
            "80C": round2(d80c),
            "80CCC": round2(d80ccc),
            "80CCD(1)": round2(d80ccd1),
            "80CCD(1B)": round2(d80ccd1b),
            "80CCD(2)": round2(d80ccd2),
            "80D": round2(d80d),
            "80E": round2(d80e),
            "80G": round2(d80g),
            "80TTA": round2(d80tta),
            "80TTB": round2(d80ttb),
            "Total Deductions": round2(total_deductions),
        },
        "Total Taxable Income": round2(taxable_income),
        "Tax Computation": {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": round2(tax_slab),
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": round2(tax_stcg_111a),
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": round2(tax_stcg_other),
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": round2(tax_ltcg_112a),
            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": round2(tax_ltcg_non_equity),
            "Tax on LTCG (Other)": round2(tax_ltcg_other),
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": round2(total_tax_before_rebate),
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": round2(rebate),
            "Tax After Rebate": round2(tax_after_rebate),
            "Surcharge": round2(surcharge),
            "Health and Education Cess": round2(cess),
            "Total Tax Liability": round2(total_tax_liability),
            "Less: TDS": round2(tds),
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": round2(net_tax),
        },
    }


def main():
    with open("input.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        data = json.load(handle)
    result = compute(data)
    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
```
