```python
def compute_salary(data, regime):
    components = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    names = ("Basic Salary", "Dearness Allowance", "HRA", "Conveyance Allowance",
             "Medical Allowance", "Bonuses and Incentives", "Overtime Pay", "LTA",
             "Special Allowance", "Entertainment Allowance")
    gross = sum(to_float(components.get(n)) for n in names)
    basic = to_float(components.get("Basic Salary"))
    da = to_float(components.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    salary_for_exemptions = basic + da

    city = str(data.get("City") or "non-metro").strip().lower()
    exempt_pct = 0.50 if city == "metro" else 0.40

    # Section 10(13A) - HRA exemption
    hra_received = to_float(components.get("HRA"))
    rent_paid = to_float(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    hra_exempt = 0.0
    if regime == "old" and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        hra_exempt = max(0.0, min(hra_received,
                                  rent_paid - 0.10 * salary_for_exemptions,
                                  exempt_pct * salary_for_exemptions))

    # Section 10(5) - LTA exemption
    lta_received = to_float(components.get("LTA"))
    lta_claimed = to_float(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    lta_exempt = 0.0
    if regime == "old" and lta_received > 0:
        lta_exempt = max(0.0, min(lta_received, lta_claimed,
                                  exempt_pct * salary_for_exemptions))

    # Section 16(ia) - standard deduction on salary
    standard_deduction = min(STANDARD_DEDUCTION, gross) if gross > 0 else 0.0

    # Section 16(ii) - professional tax actually paid
    professional_tax = 0.0
    if regime == "old":
        professional_tax = min(PROFESSIONAL_TAX_CAP,
                               to_float(data.get("Professional Tax")))

    # Section 16(iii) - entertainment allowance (government employees only)
    entertainment = 0.0
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type") or "").strip().lower()
    if regime == "old" and employment == "government":
        entertainment = 0.20 * to_float(components.get("Entertainment Allowance"))

    net_salary = (gross - hra_exempt - lta_exempt - standard_deduction
                  - professional_tax - entertainment)

    return {
        "gross": gross,
        "hra_exempt": hra_exempt,
        "lta_exempt": lta_exempt,
        "standard_deduction": standard_deduction,
        "professional_tax": professional_tax,
        "entertainment": entertainment,
        "net_salary": net_salary,
        "basic_plus_da": salary_for_exemptions,
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_capital_gains(data):
    stcg_111a = [0.0]            # equity oriented short term gain / (loss)
    ltcg_112a_new = [0.0]        # equity LTCG sold on/after 23-Jul-2024 (12.5%)
    ltcg_112a_old = [0.0]        # equity LTCG sold before 23-Jul-2024 (10%)
    ltcg_other = [0.0]           # LTCG on any other asset (slab rates)

    stcg_other = {"Bonds": [0.0], "Debentures": [0.0],
                  "G-Secs": [0.0], "Mutual Funds": [0.0]}
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": [0.0], "Debentures": [0.0],
                       "G-Secs": [0.0], "Mutual Funds": [0.0]}

    # ---- Listed / unlisted shares (equity oriented securities) -------------
    for trade in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        qty = to_float(trade.get("Quantity"))
        sale_price = to_float(trade.get("Sale Price"))
        cost_price = to_float(trade.get("Cost Price"))
        fmv = to_float(trade.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018"))
        purchase_date = parse_date(trade.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale_date = parse_date(trade.get("Sale Date"))

        total_cost = cost_price * qty
        if purchase_date is not None and purchase_date < FMV_CUTOFF and fmv > 0:
            total_cost = max(total_cost, fmv * qty)

        gain = (sale_price * qty - total_cost
                - to_float(trade.get("Brokerage")) - to_float(trade.get("STT")))

        if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
            if sale_date is not None and sale_date < LTCG_112A_RATE_CHANGE:
                ltcg_112a_old[0] += gain
            else:
                ltcg_112a_new[0] += gain
        else:
            stcg_111a[0] += gain

    # ---- Mutual fund transactions -----------------------------------------
    for fund in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(fund.get("Type") or "").strip().lower()
        purchase_date = parse_date(fund.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale_date = parse_date(fund.get("Sale Date"))
        gain = to_float(fund.get("Sale Value")) - to_float(fund.get("Purchase Value"))

        if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
            if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
                if sale_date is not None and sale_date < LTCG_112A_RATE_CHANGE:
                    ltcg_112a_old[0] += gain
                else:
                    ltcg_112a_new[0] += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a[0] += gain
        else:
            if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"][0] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"][0] += gain

    # ---- Bonds / Debentures / G-Secs --------------------------------------
    for asset_name in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(asset_name) or {}
        gain = to_float(asset.get("Sale Amount")) - to_float(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        years = to_float(asset.get("Held for duration in years"))
        if years > 1:
            ltcg_non_equity[asset_name][0] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[asset_name][0] += gain

    # ---- Set off of brought forward capital losses ------------------------
    stcg_buckets = ([stcg_111a] + [stcg_other[k] for k in
                     ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")])
    ltcg_buckets = ([ltcg_112a_new, ltcg_112a_old]
                    + [ltcg_non_equity[k] for k in
                       ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")]
                    + [ltcg_other])

    short_term_loss = sum(to_float(entry.get("Loss Amount"))
                          for entry in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or [])
    long_term_loss = sum(to_float(entry.get("Loss Amount"))
                         for entry in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or [])

    # (1) Short term capital loss against short term capital gains
    short_term_loss = set_off(short_term_loss, stcg_buckets)
    # (2) Current year short term losses against long term capital gains
    for bucket in stcg_buckets:
        absorb_loss(bucket, ltcg_buckets)
    # (3) Balance short term capital loss against long term capital gains
    short_term_loss = set_off(short_term_loss, ltcg_buckets)
    # (4) Long term capital loss against long term capital gains
    long_term_loss = set_off(long_term_loss, ltcg_buckets)

    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other[k][0] for k in stcg_other)
    ltcg_ne_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity[k][0] for k in ltcg_non_equity)

    return {
        "stcg_111a": stcg_111a[0],
        "stcg_other": {k: stcg_other[k][0] for k in stcg_other},
        "stcg_other_total": stcg_other_total,
        "ltcg_112a": ltcg_112a_new[0] + ltcg_112a_old[0],
        "ltcg_112a_new": ltcg_112a_new[0],
        "ltcg_112a_old": ltcg_112a_old[0],
        "ltcg_non_equity": {k: ltcg_non_equity[k][0] for k in ltcg_non_equity},
        "ltcg_non_equity_total": ltcg_ne_total,
        "ltcg_other": ltcg_other[0],
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deductions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def health_insurance_deduction(data, age, senior_citizen_only=False):
    total = 0.0
    for policy in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
        paid_by = str(policy.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
        if paid_by != "self":
            continue                      # employer / group cover is not deductible
        if senior_citizen_only and age < 60:
            continue                      # under the new regime 80D is for senior citizens
        purpose = str(policy.get("Payment Purpose") or "").strip().lower()
        amount = to_float(policy.get("Amount"))
        years = to_float(policy.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1.0)
        if years > 1:
            amount = amount / years      # Section 80D(5) proviso
        beneficiary = str(policy.get("Beneficiary") or "self").strip().lower()
        beneficiary_age = to_float(policy.get("Beneficiary Age"), age)
        if "check" in purpose or "preventive" in purpose:
            limit = 5000.0
        elif beneficiary in ("father", "mother", "parent", "parents"):
            limit = 50000.0 if beneficiary_age >= 60 else 25000.0
        else:
            limit = 50000.0 if beneficiary_age >= 60 else 25000.0
        total += min(amount, limit)
    return total


def donation_deduction(data, gross_income, new_regime=False):
    total = 0.0
    for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
        scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name") or "").strip().lower()
        amount = to_float(donation.get("Amount"))
        mode = str(donation.get("Mode") or "").strip().lower()
        if new_regime:
            if scheme not in NEW_REGIME_80G_SCHEMES:
                continue
            rate, qualifying_limit = 1.00, False
        else:
            rate, qualifying_limit = DONATION_RULES.get(scheme, (0.50, False))
        deduction = amount * rate
        if qualifying_limit:
            deduction = min(deduction, 0.02 * gross_income)
        if mode == "cash":
            deduction = min(deduction, amount * 0.50)   # Section 80G(1) proviso
        total += deduction
    return total


def compute_deductions(data, regime, age, gross_income, basic_plus_da):
    deductions = {
        "80C": 0.0, "80CCC": 0.0, "80CCD(1)": 0.0, "80CCD(1B)": 0.0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0.0, "80D": 0.0, "80E": 0.0, "80G": 0.0,
        "80TTA": 0.0, "80TTB": 0.0,
    }

    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_self = to_float(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    nps_employer = to_float(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    nps_tier2 = to_float(nps.get("Tier-2"))

    if regime == "old":
        # Section 80C
        items = (to_float(data.get("PPF")) + to_float(data.get("ELSS"))
                 + to_float(data.get("NSC"))
                 + to_float(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
                 + to_float(data.get("SCSS")))
        epf = data.get("EPF") or {}
        employee = epf.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
        items += (to_float(employee.get("Deducted from Salary"))
                  + to_float(employee.get("Voluntary")))
        pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
        premium = to_float(pension.get("Amount"))
        years = to_float(pension.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1.0)
        if years > 1:
            premium = premium / years      # premium covers multiple years
        items += premium
        deductions["80C"] = min(items, LIMIT_80C)

        # Section 80CCC - Agniveer contribution (not part of the input schema)
        deductions["80CCC"] = 0.0

        # Section 80CCD(1) - NPS tier-1 (self + employer contribution credited)
        deductions["80CCD(1)"] = min(nps_self + nps_employer, LIMIT_80CCD1)

        # Section 80CCD(1B) - additional NPS contribution (senior citizens)
        if age >= 60:
            deductions["80CCD(1B)"] = min(nps_tier2, LIMIT_80CCD1B)

        # Section 80CCD(2) - employer's own deduction, not available to an
        # individual assessee.
        deductions["80CCD(2)"] = 0.0

        # Section 80D - health insurance premium
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance_deduction(data, age)

        # Section 80E - education loan interest (allowed for 8 years)
        education = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
        interest = to_float(education.get("Interest Paid"))
        year_of_repayment = to_float(education.get("Year of Repayment"), 1.0)
        deductions["80E"] = interest if year_of_repayment <= 8 else 0.0

        # Section 80G - donations
        deductions["80G"] = donation_deduction(data, gross_income)

        # Section 80TTA / 80TTB - savings / deposit interest
        if age < 60:
            deductions["80TTA"] = min(to_float(data.get("Savings Bank Interest")),
                                     LIMIT_80TTA)
        else:
            deductions["80TTB"] = min(to_float(data.get("Deposit Interest")),
                                     LIMIT_80TTB)
    else:
        # New regime (Section 115BAC): only 80C(2), 80D (senior citizens),
        # 80G (PM CARES / Drought Relief) and 80JJAA are allowed.
        deductions["80C"] = min(nps_employer, 0.14 * basic_plus_da)
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance_deduction(data, age,
                                                        senior_citizen_only=True)
        deductions["80G"] = donation_deduction(data, gross_income,
                                               new_regime=True)

    deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())
    return deductions


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tax computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rebate_87a(income, tax, regime):
    if tax <= 0:
        return 0.0
    if regime == "old":
        if income <= 360000:
            return min(tax, 12500.0)
        if income <= 500000:
            return min(tax, 25000.0)
        return 0.0
    if income <= 800000:
        return min(tax, 25000.0)
    if income <= 1200000:
        return min(tax, 60000.0)
    if income <= 1200500:
        return max(0.0, min(tax, 60000.0 - (income - 1200000)))
    return 0.0


def surcharge_amount(income, tax, slabs):
    if income <= 5000000 or tax <= 0:
        return 0.0
    if income <= 10000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.10, 5000000.0
    elif income <= 20000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.15, 10000000.0
    elif income <= 50000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.25, 20000000.0
    else:
        rate, threshold = 0.37, 50000000.0
    surcharge = tax * rate
    # Marginal relief: tax + surcharge cannot exceed the tax at the threshold
    # plus the income over the threshold.
    max_surcharge = max(0.0, income - threshold)
    return min(surcharge, max_surcharge)


def compute_tax(total_taxable_income, capital, regime):
    slabs = OLD_REGIME_SLABS if regime == "old" else NEW_REGIME_SLABS

    stcg_111a = capital["stcg_111a"]
    ltcg_112a_new = capital["ltcg_112a_new"]
    ltcg_112a_old = capital["ltcg_112a_old"]
    stcg_other = capital["stcg_other_total"]
    ltcg_ne = capital["ltcg_non_equity_total"]
    ltcg_other = capital["ltcg_other"]

    # Income taxed at slab rates (ordinary income)
    ordinary = (total_taxable_income - stcg_111a - ltcg_112a_new
                - ltcg_112a_old - stcg_other - ltcg_ne - ltcg_other)

    tax_at_slab = slab_tax(ordinary, slabs)

    tax_111a = STCG_111A_RATE * stcg_111a if stcg_111a > 0 else 0.0

    tax_112a = 0.0
    if ltcg_112a_new > 0:
        tax_112a += LTCG_112A_RATE * ltcg_112a_new
    if ltcg_112a_old > 0:
        tax_112a += LTCG_112A_PRE_RATE * ltcg_112a_old

    # Slab rate taxes on the remaining capital gains (shown separately so that
    # no income is taxed twice)
    tax_stcg_other = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other, slabs)
                      - slab_tax(ordinary, slabs))
    tax_ltcg_ne = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne, slabs)
                   - slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other, slabs))
    tax_ltcg_other = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne + ltcg_other, slabs)
                      - slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne, slabs))

    total_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab + tax_111a + tax_112a + tax_stcg_other
                           + tax_ltcg_ne + tax_ltcg_other)
    rebate = rebate_87a(total_taxable_income, total_before_rebate, regime)
    tax_after_rebate = total_before_rebate - rebate
    surcharge = surcharge_amount(total_taxable_income, tax_after_rebate, slabs)
    cess = CESS_RATE * (tax_after_rebate + surcharge)
    total_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

    return {
        "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slab,
        "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_111a,
        "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_stcg_other,
        "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_112a,
        "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_ltcg_ne,
        "Tax on LTCG (Other)": tax_ltcg_other,
        "Total Tax Before Rebate": total_before_rebate,
        "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": rebate,
        "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
        "Surcharge": surcharge,
        "Health and Education Cess": cess,
        "Total Tax Liability": total_liability,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Top level
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_tax_output(data):
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime") or "old").strip().lower()
    if regime not in ("old", "new"):
        regime = "old"
```

```python
def to_float(value, default=0.0):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return default

                "%d-%b-%Y", "%d %b %Y", "%d-%B-%Y", "%d %B %Y"):

def is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):

              + (sale_date.month - purchase_date.month))
    if months > 12:

def slab_tax(income, slabs):

        lower = upper

    return remaining


def absorb_loss(bucket, gain_buckets):
    """Set off a loss sitting in `bucket` against gains in `gain_buckets`."""
    if bucket[0] >= 0:
        return
    loss = -bucket[0]
    remaining = set_off(loss, gain_buckets)
    bucket[0] += (loss - remaining)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Salaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_salary(data, regime):
    components = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    names = ("Basic Salary", "Dearness Allowance", "HRA", "Conveyance Allowance",
             "Medical Allowance", "Bonuses and Incentives", "Overtime Pay", "LTA",
             "Special Allowance", "Entertainment Allowance")
    gross = sum(to_float(components.get(n)) for n in names)
    basic = to_float(components.get("Basic Salary"))
    da = to_float(components.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    salary_for_exemptions = basic + da

    city = str(data.get("City") or "non-metro").strip().lower()
    exempt_pct = 0.50 if city == "metro" else 0.40

    # Section 10(13A) - HRA exemption
    hra_received = to_float(components.get("HRA"))
    rent_paid = to_float(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    hra_exempt = 0.0
    if regime == "old" and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        hra_exempt = max(0.0, min(hra_received,
                                  rent_paid - 0.10 * salary_for_exemptions,
                                  exempt_pct * salary_for_exemptions))

    # Section 10(5) - LTA exemption
    lta_received = to_float(components.get("LTA"))
    lta_claimed = to_float(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    lta_exempt = 0.0
    if regime == "old" and lta_received > 0:
        lta_exempt = max(0.0, min(lta_received, lta_claimed,
                                  exempt_pct * salary_for_exemptions))

    # Section 16(ia) - standard deduction on salary
    standard_deduction = min(STANDARD_DEDUCTION, gross) if gross > 0 else 0.0

    # Section 16(ii) - professional tax actually paid
    professional_tax = 0.0
    if regime == "old":
        professional_tax = min(PROFESSIONAL_TAX_CAP,
                               to_float(data.get("Professional Tax")))

    # Section 16(iii) - entertainment allowance (government employees only)
    entertainment = 0.0
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type") or "").strip().lower()
    if regime == "old" and employment == "government":
        entertainment = 0.20 * to_float(components.get("Entertainment Allowance"))

    net_salary = (gross - hra_exempt - lta_exempt - standard_deduction
                  - professional_tax - entertainment)

    return {
        "gross": gross,
        "hra_exempt": hra_exempt,
        "lta_exempt": lta_exempt,
        "standard_deduction": standard_deduction,
        "professional_tax": professional_tax,
        "entertainment": entertainment,
        "net_salary": net_salary,
        "basic_plus_da": salary_for_exemptions,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Capital gains
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_capital_gains(data):
    stcg_111a = [0.0]            # equity oriented short term gain / (loss)
    ltcg_112a_new = [0.0]        # equity LTCG sold on/after 23-Jul-2024 (12.5%)
    ltcg_112a_old = [0.0]        # equity LTCG sold before 23-Jul-2024 (10%)
    ltcg_other = [0.0]           # LTCG on any other asset (slab rates)

    stcg_other = {"Bonds": [0.0], "Debentures": [0.0],
                  "G-Secs": [0.0], "Mutual Funds": [0.0]}
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": [0.0], "Debentures": [0.0],
                       "G-Secs": [0.0], "Mutual Funds": [0.0]}

    # ---- Listed / unlisted shares (equity oriented securities) -------------
    for trade in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        qty = to_float(trade.get("Quantity"))
        sale_price = to_float(trade.get("Sale Price"))
        cost_price = to_float(trade.get("Cost Price"))
        fmv = to_float(trade.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018"))
        purchase_date = parse_date(trade.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale_date = parse_date(trade.get("Sale Date"))

        total_cost = cost_price * qty
        if purchase_date is not None and purchase_date < FMV_CUTOFF and fmv > 0:
            total_cost = max(total_cost, fmv * qty)

        gain = (sale_price * qty - total_cost
                - to_float(trade.get("Brokerage")) - to_float(trade.get("STT")))

        if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
            if sale_date is not None and sale_date < LTCG_112A_RATE_CHANGE:
                ltcg_112a_old[0] += gain
            else:
                ltcg_112a_new[0] += gain
        else:
            stcg_111a[0] += gain

    # ---- Mutual fund transactions -----------------------------------------
    for fund in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(fund.get("Type") or "").strip().lower()
        purchase_date = parse_date(fund.get("Purchase Date"))
        sale_date = parse_date(fund.get("Sale Date"))
        gain = to_float(fund.get("Sale Value")) - to_float(fund.get("Purchase Value"))

        if fund_type in EQUITY_FUND_TYPES:
            if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
                if sale_date is not None and sale_date < LTCG_112A_RATE_CHANGE:
                    ltcg_112a_old[0] += gain
                else:
                    ltcg_112a_new[0] += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a[0] += gain
        else:
            if is_long_term(purchase_date, sale_date):
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"][0] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"][0] += gain

    # ---- Bonds / Debentures / G-Secs --------------------------------------
    for asset_name in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(asset_name) or {}
        gain = to_float(asset.get("Sale Amount")) - to_float(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        years = to_float(asset.get("Held for duration in years"))
        if years > 1:
            ltcg_non_equity[asset_name][0] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[asset_name][0] += gain

    # ---- Set off of brought forward capital losses ------------------------
    stcg_buckets = ([stcg_111a]
                    + [stcg_other[k] for k in
                       ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")])
    ltcg_buckets = ([ltcg_112a_new, ltcg_112a_old]
                    + [ltcg_non_equity[k] for k in
                       ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds")]
                    + [ltcg_other])

    short_term_loss = sum(to_float(entry.get("Loss Amount"))
                          for entry in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or [])
    long_term_loss = sum(to_float(entry.get("Loss Amount"))
                         for entry in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or [])

    # (1) Brought forward short term capital loss against short term gains
    short_term_loss = set_off(short_term_loss, stcg_buckets)
    # (2) Current year short term losses against long term capital gains
    for bucket in stcg_buckets:
        absorb_loss(bucket, ltcg_buckets)
    # (3) Balance short term capital loss against long term capital gains
    short_term_loss = set_off(short_term_loss, ltcg_buckets)
    # (4) Long term capital loss against long term capital gains
    long_term_loss = set_off(long_term_loss, ltcg_buckets)

    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other[k][0] for k in stcg_other)
    ltcg_ne_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity[k][0] for k in ltcg_non_equity)

    return {
        "stcg_111a": stcg_111a[0],
        "stcg_other": {k: stcg_other[k][0] for k in stcg_other},
        "stcg_other_total": stcg_other_total,
        "ltcg_112a": ltcg_112a_new[0] + ltcg_112a_old[0],
        "ltcg_112a_new": ltcg_112a_new[0],
        "ltcg_112a_old": ltcg_112a_old[0],
        "ltcg_non_equity": {k: ltcg_non_equity[k][0] for k in ltcg_non_equity},
        "ltcg_non_equity_total": ltcg_ne_total,
        "ltcg_other": ltcg_other[0],
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deductions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def health_insurance_deduction(data, age, senior_citizen_only=False):
    total = 0.0
    for policy in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
        paid_by = str(policy.get("Paid By") or "").strip().lower()
        if paid_by != "self":
            continue                      # employer / group cover is not deductible
        if senior_citizen_only and age < 60:
            continue                      # under the new regime 80D is for senior citizens
        purpose = str(policy.get("Payment Purpose") or "").strip().lower()
        amount = to_float(policy.get("Amount"))
        years = to_float(policy.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1.0)
        if years > 1:
            amount = amount / years      # Section 80D(5) proviso
        beneficiary = str(policy.get("Beneficiary") or "self").strip().lower()
        beneficiary_age = to_float(policy.get("Beneficiary Age"), age)
        if "check" in purpose or "preventive" in purpose:
            limit = 5000.0
        elif beneficiary in ("father", "mother", "parent", "parents"):
            limit = 50000.0 if beneficiary_age >= 60 else 25000.0
        else:
            limit = 50000.0 if beneficiary_age >= 60 else 25000.0
        total += min(amount, limit)
    return total


def donation_deduction(data, gross_income, new_regime=False):
    total = 0.0
    for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
        scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name") or "").strip().lower()
        amount = to_float(donation.get("Amount"))
        mode = str(donation.get("Mode") or "").strip().lower()
        if new_regime:
            if scheme not in NEW_REGIME_80G_SCHEMES:
                continue
            rate, qualifying_limit = 1.00, False
        else:
            rate, qualifying_limit = DONATION_RULES.get(scheme, (0.50, False))
        deduction = amount * rate
        if qualifying_limit:
            deduction = min(deduction, 0.02 * gross_income)
        if mode == "cash":
            deduction = min(deduction, amount * 0.50)   # Section 80G(1) proviso
        total += deduction
    return total


def compute_deductions(data, regime, age, gross_income, basic_plus_da):
    deductions = {
        "80C": 0.0, "80CCC": 0.0, "80CCD(1)": 0.0, "80CCD(1B)": 0.0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0.0, "80D": 0.0, "80E": 0.0, "80G": 0.0,
        "80TTA": 0.0, "80TTB": 0.0,
    }

    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    nps_self = to_float(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    nps_employer = to_float(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    nps_tier2 = to_float(nps.get("Tier-2"))

    if regime == "old":
        # Section 80C
        items = (to_float(data.get("PPF")) + to_float(data.get("ELSS"))
                 + to_float(data.get("NSC"))
                 + to_float(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
                 + to_float(data.get("SCSS")))
        epf = data.get("EPF") or {}
        employee = epf.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
        items += (to_float(employee.get("Deducted from Salary"))
                  + to_float(employee.get("Voluntary")))
        pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
        premium = to_float(pension.get("Amount"))
        years = to_float(pension.get("Number of Years Paid"), 1.0)
        if years > 1:
            premium = premium / years      # premium covers multiple years
        items += premium
        deductions["80C"] = min(items, LIMIT_80C)

        # Section 80CCC - Agniveer contribution (not part of the input schema)
        deductions["80CCC"] = 0.0

        # Section 80CCD(1) - NPS tier-1 (self + employer contribution credited)
        deductions["80CCD(1)"] = min(nps_self + nps_employer, LIMIT_80CCD1)

        # Section 80CCD(1B) - additional NPS contribution (senior citizens)
        if age >= 60:
            deductions["80CCD(1B)"] = min(nps_tier2, LIMIT_80CCD1B)

        # Section 80CCD(2) - employer's own deduction, not available to an
        # individual assessee.
        deductions["80CCD(2)"] = 0.0

        # Section 80D - health insurance premium
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance_deduction(data, age)

        # Section 80E - education loan interest (allowed for 8 years)
        education = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
        interest = to_float(education.get("Interest Paid"))
        year_of_repayment = to_float(education.get("Year of Repayment"), 1.0)
        deductions["80E"] = interest if year_of_repayment <= 8 else 0.0

        # Section 80G - donations
        deductions["80G"] = donation_deduction(data, gross_income)

        # Section 80TTA / 80TTB - savings / deposit interest
        if age < 60:
            deductions["80TTA"] = min(to_float(data.get("Savings Bank Interest")),
                                     LIMIT_80TTA)
        else:
            deductions["80TTB"] = min(to_float(data.get("Deposit Interest")),
                                     LIMIT_80TTB)
    else:
        # New regime (Section 115BAC): only 80C(2), 80D (senior citizens),
        # 80G (PM CARES / Drought Relief) and 80JJAA are allowed.
        deductions["80C"] = min(nps_employer, 0.14 * basic_plus_da)
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance_deduction(data, age,
                                                        senior_citizen_only=True)
        deductions["80G"] = donation_deduction(data, gross_income,
                                               new_regime=True)

    deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())
    return deductions


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tax computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rebate_87a(income, tax, regime):
    if tax <= 0:
        return 0.0
    if regime == "old":
        if income <= 360000:
            return min(tax, 12500.0)
        if income <= 500000:
            return min(tax, 25000.0)
        return 0.0
    if income <= 800000:
        return min(tax, 25000.0)
    if income <= 1200000:
        return min(tax, 60000.0)
    if income <= 1200500:
        return max(0.0, min(tax, 60000.0 - (income - 1200000)))
    return 0.0


def surcharge_amount(income, tax):
    if income <= 5000000 or tax <= 0:
        return 0.0
    if income <= 10000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.10, 5000000.0
    elif income <= 20000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.15, 10000000.0
    elif income <= 50000000:
        rate, threshold = 0.25, 20000000.0
    else:
        rate, threshold = 0.37, 50000000.0
    surcharge = tax * rate
    # Marginal relief: tax + surcharge cannot exceed the tax at the threshold
    # plus the income over the threshold.
    max_surcharge = max(0.0, income - threshold)
    return min(surcharge, max_surcharge)


def compute_tax(total_taxable_income, capital, regime):
    slabs = OLD_REGIME_SLABS if regime == "old" else NEW_REGIME_SLABS

    stcg_111a = capital["stcg_111a"]
    ltcg_112a_new = capital["ltcg_112a_new"]
    ltcg_112a_old = capital["ltcg_112a_old"]
    stcg_other = capital["stcg_other_total"]
    ltcg_ne = capital["ltcg_non_equity_total"]
    ltcg_other = capital["ltcg_other"]

    # Income taxed at slab rates (ordinary income)
    ordinary = (total_taxable_income - stcg_111a - ltcg_112a_new
                - ltcg_112a_old - stcg_other - ltcg_ne - ltcg_other)

    tax_at_slab = slab_tax(ordinary, slabs)

    tax_111a = STCG_111A_RATE * stcg_111a if stcg_111a > 0 else 0.0

    tax_112a = 0.0
    if ltcg_112a_new > 0:
        tax_112a += LTCG_112A_RATE * ltcg_112a_new
    if ltcg_112a_old > 0:
        tax_112a += LTCG_112A_PRE_RATE * ltcg_112a_old

    # Slab rate taxes on the remaining capital gains (shown separately so that
    # no income is taxed twice)
    tax_stcg_other = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other, slabs)
                      - slab_tax(ordinary, slabs))
    tax_ltcg_ne = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne, slabs)
                   - slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other, slabs))
    tax_ltcg_other = (slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne + ltcg_other, slabs)
                      - slab_tax(ordinary + stcg_other + ltcg_ne, slabs))

    total_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab + tax_111a + tax_112a + tax_stcg_other
                           + tax_ltcg_ne + tax_ltcg_other)
    rebate = rebate_87a(total_taxable_income, total_before_rebate, regime)
    tax_after_rebate = total_before_rebate - rebate
    surcharge = surcharge_amount(total_taxable_income, tax_after_rebate)
    cess = CESS_RATE * (tax_after_rebate + surcharge)
    total_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

    return {
        "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slab,
        "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_111a,
        "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_stcg_other,
        "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_112a,
        "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_ltcg_ne,
        "Tax on LTCG (Other)": tax_ltcg_other,
        "Total Tax Before Rebate": total_before_rebate,
        "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": rebate,
        "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
        "Surcharge": surcharge,
        "Health and Education Cess": cess,
        "Total Tax Liability": total_liability,
    }

# Top level
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_tax_output(data):
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime") or "old").strip().lower()
    if regime not in ("old", "new"):
        regime = "old"
    age = to_float(data.get("Age"))

    salary = compute_salary(data, regime)
    capital = compute_capital_gains(data)

    savings_interest = to_float(data.get("Savings Bank Interest"))
    deposit_interest = to_float(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = to_float(data.get("Other Interest"))
    epf_interest = to_float(data.get("EPF Taxable Interest"))
    other_sources_total = (savings_interest + deposit_interest
                            + other_interest + epf_interest)

    capital_total = (capital["stcg_111a"] + capital["stcg_other_total"]
                     + capital["ltcg_112a"] + capital["ltcg_non_equity_total"]
                     + capital["ltcg_other"])

    gross_total_income = salary["net_salary"] + capital_total + other_sources_total

    deductions = compute_deductions(data, regime, age, gross_total_income,
                                    salary["basic_plus_da"])
    total_deductions = deductions["Total Deductions"]
    total_taxable_income = gross_total_income - total_deductions

    tax = compute_tax(total_taxable_income, capital, regime)
    tds = to_float(data.get("TDS"))

    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": r2(salary["gross"]),
            "Exemptions": {
                "Section 10(13A)": r2(salary["hra_exempt"]),
                "Section 10(5)": r2(salary["lta_exempt"]),
            },
            "Section 16(ia)": r2(salary["standard_deduction"]),
            "Section 16(ii)": r2(salary["professional_tax"]),
            "Section 16(iii)": r2(salary["entertainment"]),
            "Net Salary": r2(salary["net_salary"]),
        },
        "Capital Gains": {
            "STCG (Section 111A)": r2(capital["stcg_111a"]),
            "STCG (Other)": {

                "Debentures": r2(capital["stcg_other"]["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": r2(capital["stcg_other"]["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": r2(capital["stcg_other"]["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": r2(capital["stcg_other_total"]),
            },
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": r2(capital["ltcg_112a"]),
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": {
                "Bonds": r2(capital["ltcg_non_equity"]["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": r2(capital["ltcg_non_equity"]["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": r2(capital["ltcg_non_equity"]["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": r2(capital["ltcg_non_equity"]["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": r2(capital["ltcg_non_equity_total"]),
            },
            "LTCG (Other)": r2(capital["ltcg_other"]),
        },
        "Income from Other Sources": {
            "Savings Bank Interest": r2(savings_interest),
            "Deposit Interest": r2(deposit_interest),
            "Other Interest": r2(other_interest),
            "EPF Taxable Interest": r2(epf_interest),
        },
        "Gross Total Income": r2(gross_total_income),
        "Deductions": {
            "80C": r2(deductions["80C"]),
            "80CCC": r2(deductions["80CCC"]),
            "80CCD(1)": r2(deductions["80CCD(1)"]),
            "80CCD(1B)": r2(deductions["80CCD(1B)"]),
            "80CCD(2)": r2(deductions["80CCD(2)"]),
            "80D": r2(deductions["80D"]),
            "80E": r2(deductions["80E"]),
            "80G": r2(deductions["80G"]),
            "80TTA": r2(deductions["80TTA"]),
            "80TTB": r2(deductions["80TTB"]),
            "Total Deductions": r2(total_deductions),
        },
        "Total Taxable Income": r2(total_taxable_income),
        "Tax Computation": {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": r2(tax["Tax at Slab Rates"]),
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": r2(tax["Tax on STCG (Section 111A)"]),
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": r2(tax["Tax on STCG (Other)"]),
```

      each { "Sale Amount", "Purchase Amount", "Held for duration in years" }
- "Savings Bank Interest": number
- "Deposit Interest": number
- "Other Interest": number           <-- a plain amount, not a container
- "EPF Taxable Interest": number     <-- a sibling of the above, not nested inside it
- "PPF", "ELSS", "NSC", "Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana", "SCSS": numbers
- "EPF": { "Employee Contribution": { "Deducted from Salary", "Voluntary" },
           "Employer Contribution" }
- "Pension Scheme Premium": { "Amount", "Number of Years Paid" }
- "NPS": { "Tier-1 Self Contribution", "Tier-1 Employer Contribution", "Tier-2" }
- "Education Loan Interest": { "Interest Paid", "Year of Repayment" }
- "Health Insurance": [ { "Payment Purpose", "Number of Years Paid", "Beneficiary",
                          "Beneficiary Age", "Paid By", "Payment Mode", "Amount" } ]
- "Donations": [ { "Scheme Name", "Amount", "Mode" } ]
- "TDS": number

Use the values exactly as given. Do not substitute a statutory default for a
declared figure, even when the declared figure is 0.

## Input field interpretation

These clarify the semantics of certain input fields — they are NOT tax rules:

- "FMV as of 31 Jan 2018": Fair Market Value of the stock on 31-Jan-2018.
- "Pension Scheme Premium → Number of Years Paid": If > 1, the premium covers multiple years.
- "Health Insurance → Number of Years Paid": If > 1, the premium covers multiple years.
- "Education Loan Interest → Year of Repayment": The Nth year of the repayment schedule (e.g. 1 = first year, 5 = fifth year). This is NOT a calendar or fiscal year.
- "Held for duration in years" (for Bonds, Debentures, G-Secs, Privately Owned Vehicle): Integer years the asset was held.
- "Health Insurance → Paid By": "self" means the individual paid; "group medical insurance" means employer-provided coverage.
- "Stock Sale Transactions → STT": Securities Transaction Tax paid on the transaction.
- "Long/Short Term Capital Loss → Financial Year": The FY when the loss was originally incurred, in "YYYY-YY" format (e.g. "2020-21").
- "Mutual Fund Transactions → Type": One of: equity, debt, elss, gold-etf, gold-mf, international, hybrid-equity.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Indian income-tax calculator for FY 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27).

Reads the taxpayer JSON from ``input.json`` in the current working directory
and prints the tax computation (exactly the schema documented in the task) as
a single JSON object on stdout.  Nothing else is ever written to stdout.

Conventions used (all FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 rates):

Salaries
  * HRA exemption (s.10(13A)): least of actual rent paid, 50% of (basic + DA)
    for metro cities / 40% otherwise, and 10% of (basic + DA).
  * LTA exemption (s.10(5)): least of the LTA received and the actual travel
    expenses claimed.
  * s.16(ia) professional tax, s.16(ii) employee's EPF contribution and
    s.16(iii) employer's EPF contribution (taxable for government employees;
    exempt u/s 10(10) for private employees).
  * The standard deduction has no key in the output schema, so it is disabled
    by default (see APPLY_STANDARD_DEDUCTION below).

Capital gains
  * Listed equity (shares, equity / hybrid-equity / international funds):
    long term when held for more than 12 months -> s.112A (12.5%); otherwise
    short term -> s.111A (20%).
  * Debt / ELSS funds: long term when held for more than 24 months -> s.112
    (20%); otherwise short term (slab rates).
  * Gold ETF / gold funds: long term when held for more than 24 months ->
    s.112 (20%); otherwise short term (slab rates).
  * Bonds / debentures / G-Secs: long term when held for more than 12 months
    -> s.112 (20%); otherwise short term (slab rates).
  * A privately owned vehicle is a personal asset and is not a capital asset
    u/s 2(14); its sale is therefore not reported as a capital gain.
  * The s.112A exemption of Rs. 1,25,000 is allowed only when the total
    income (computed before that exemption) does not exceed Rs. 10,00,000
    (old regime) / Rs. 20,00,000 (new regime) - s.112A(3).
  * Capital losses: short term losses are set off against short term gains
    first and then against long term gains; long term losses are set off
    against long term gains only.

Deductions (old regime): 80C, 80CCC, 80CCD(1), 80CCD(1B), 80CCD(2), 80D,
80E, 80G, 80TTA and 80TTB.  In the new regime only 80CCD(2) (and the 80CCH
additional NPS relief, reported under the 80CCD(1B) line because the schema
has no dedicated key) is allowed.

Tax: slab rates for ordinary income and for short term capital gains other
than s.111A, 20% for s.111A and for non-equity long term gains, 12.5% for
s.112A, s.87A rebate, surcharge and 4% health & education cess.
"""

import json
import sys
from datetime import date

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration / statutory constants (FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

INPUT_FILE = "input.json"

# The output schema has no key for the standard deduction, so it is off by
# default; when enabled it is absorbed in "Net Salary".
APPLY_STANDARD_DEDUCTION = False
STANDARD_DEDUCTION_OLD = 50000
STANDARD_DEDUCTION_NEW = 75000

# s.112A(3): the Rs. 1,25,000 exemption on eligible equity LTCG is unavailable
# when the total income (computed before that exemption) exceeds these limits.
APPLY_112A_TOTAL_INCOME_LIMIT = True
LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION = 125000
LTCG_112A_LIMIT_OLD = 1000000
LTCG_112A_LIMIT_NEW = 2000000

RATE_STCG_111A = 0.20
RATE_LTCG_112A = 0.125
RATE_LTCG_OTHER = 0.20
CESS_RATE = 0.04

LIMIT_80C = 150000
LIMIT_80CCC = 50000
LIMIT_80CCD1 = 50000
LIMIT_80CCD1B = 50000
LIMIT_80CCD2_RATE = 0.10          # 10% of (basic + DA)
LIMIT_80E_YEARS = 8

# 80G: schemes eligible for a 100% deduction without any qualifying limit.
DONATION_RATES_100 = {
    "pm cares fund",
    "pm cares",
    "pmcares",
    "national relief fund",
    "prime minister's national relief fund",
    "prime ministers national relief fund",
    "chief minister's relief fund",
    "chief minister relief fund",
    "cmrf",
}
# 80G: schemes eligible for a 50% deduction without any qualifying limit.
DONATION_RATES_50 = {
    "swachh bharat kosh",
    "national child development fund",
    "national sports fund",
    "national education fund",
    "indian kalam fund",
    "scientific research fund",
    "approved research fund",
    "approved scientific research fund",
}

# Capital losses may be carried forward for 8 assessment years.
LOSS_CARRY_FORWARD_YEARS = 8
CURRENT_FY_START_YEAR = 2025


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Small helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _f(value, default=0.0):
    """Coerce a JSON value to float (None / junk -> default)."""
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _r(value):
    """Round to 2 decimals and normalise -0.0 to 0.0."""
    result = round(_f(value) + 0.0, 2)
    return 0.0 if result == 0 else result


def _parse_date(value):
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _months_between(start, end):
    """Whole months between two dates (0 if either date is missing)."""
    if not start or not end:
        return 0
    months = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month)
    if end.day < start.day:
        months -= 1
    return months


def _slab_tax(income, slabs):
    """Tax on `income` for a list of (upper_limit, rate) slabs."""
    if income <= 0:
        return 0.0
    tax = 0.0
    lower = 0.0
    for upper, rate in slabs:
        if upper is None or income <= upper:
            tax += (income - lower) * rate
            break
        tax += (upper - lower) * rate
        lower = upper
    return tax


def _old_regime_slabs(age):
    if age < 60:
        return [(250000, 0.0), (500000, 0.05), (1000000, 0.20), (None, 0.30)]
    if age < 80:
        return [(300000, 0.0), (500000, 0.05), (1000000, 0.20), (None, 0.30)]
    return [(500000, 0.0), (1000000, 0.20), (None, 0.30)]


def _new_regime_slabs():
    # FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) new regime slabs.
    return [(400000, 0.0), (800000, 0.05), (1200000, 0.10), (1600000, 0.15),
            (2000000, 0.20), (2400000, 0.30), (None, 0.37)]


def _rebate_87a(tax, total_income, regime):
    if regime == "new":
        if total_income <= 1200000:
            return min(tax, 60000.0)
    else:
        if total_income <= 500000:
            return min(tax, 12500.0)
    return 0.0


def _surcharge(tax, total_income, regime):
    """Surcharge on tax (marginal-relief rules are not modelled)."""
    if total_income > 5000000:
        rate = 0.37 if regime == "old" else 0.25
    elif total_income > 2000000:
        rate = 0.25
    elif total_income > 1000000:
        rate = 0.15
    elif total_income > 500000:
        rate = 0.10
    else:
        rate = 0.0
    return tax * rate


def _set_off_capital_losses(stcg_111a, stcg_other, ltcg_112a, ltcg_non_equity,
                            ltcg_other, stcl, ltcl):
    """Set off capital losses and return the reduced gain buckets."""
    stcg_other = dict(stcg_other)
    ltcg_non_equity = dict(ltcg_non_equity)

    # 1) Short term capital loss against short term capital gains.
    loss = stcl
    used = min(loss, max(0.0, stcg_111a))
    stcg_111a -= used
    loss -= used
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds"):
        used = min(loss, max(0.0, stcg_other[key]))
        stcg_other[key] -= used
        loss -= used

    # 2) Short term capital loss against long term capital gains.
    used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_112a))
    ltcg_112a -= used
    loss -= used
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds"):
        used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_non_equity[key]))
        ltcg_non_equity[key] -= used
        loss -= used
    used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_other))
    ltcg_other -= used
    loss -= used

    # 3) Long term capital loss against long term capital gains only.
    loss = ltcl
    used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_112a))
    ltcg_112a -= used
    loss -= used
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs", "Mutual Funds"):
        used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_non_equity[key]))
        ltcg_non_equity[key] -= used
        loss -= used
    used = min(loss, max(0.0, ltcg_other))
    ltcg_other -= used

    return stcg_111a, stcg_other, ltcg_112a, ltcg_non_equity, ltcg_other


def _usable_loss(financial_year):
    """Capital losses can be carried forward for 8 assessment years."""
    try:
        start_year = int(str(financial_year).split("-")[0])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        return True
    return start_year >= CURRENT_FY_START_YEAR - LOSS_CARRY_FORWARD_YEARS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main computation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def compute_tax(data):
    age = _f(data.get("Age"))
    employment = str(data.get("Employment Type", "private")).strip().lower()
    regime = str(data.get("Tax Regime", "old")).strip().lower()
    city = str(data.get("City", "non-metro")).strip().lower()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Salaries
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    salary_map = data.get("Gross Salary") or {}
    salary_keys = ("Basic Salary", "Dearness Allowance", "HRA", "Conveyance Allowance",
                   "Medical Allowance", "Bonuses and Incentives", "Overtime Pay", "LTA",
                   "Special Allowance", "Entertainment Allowance")
    gross_salary = sum(_f(salary_map.get(k)) for k in salary_keys)

    basic = _f(salary_map.get("Basic Salary"))
    dearness = _f(salary_map.get("Dearness Allowance"))
    hra_received = _f(salary_map.get("HRA"))
    lta_received = _f(salary_map.get("LTA"))
    salary_for_hra = basic + dearness

    # HRA exemption u/s 10(13A)
    rent_paid = _f(data.get("Actual Rent Paid"))
    if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0 and salary_for_hra > 0:
        rent_percent = 0.50 if city == "metro" else 0.40
        exempt_hra = min(rent_paid,
                         rent_percent * salary_for_hra,
                         0.10 * salary_for_hra)
    else:
        exempt_hra = 0.0

    # LTA exemption u/s 10(5)
    travel_claimed = _f(data.get("LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"))
    exempt_lta = min(lta_received, travel_claimed) if lta_received > 0 else 0.0

    # Section 16 deductions
    sec16_ia = _f(data.get("Professional Tax"))
    epf = data.get("EPF") or {}
    employee_contrib = epf.get("Employee Contribution") or {}
    sec16_ii = (_f(employee_contrib.get("Deducted from Salary"))
                + _f(employee_contrib.get("Voluntary")))
    employer_epf = _f(epf.get("Employer Contribution"))
    # Employer's EPF contribution is taxable for government employees (no
    # s.16(iii) relief); for private employees it is exempt u/s 10(10).
    sec16_iii = employer_epf if employment == "government" else 0.0

    standard_deduction = 0.0
    if APPLY_STANDARD_DEDUCTION:
        standard_deduction = (STANDARD_DEDUCTION_NEW if regime == "new"
                              else STANDARD_DEDUCTION_OLD)

    net_salary = (gross_salary - exempt_hra - exempt_lta - sec16_ia
                  - sec16_ii - sec16_iii - standard_deduction)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Income from other sources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    savings_interest = _f(data.get("Savings Bank Interest"))
    deposit_interest = _f(data.get("Deposit Interest"))
    other_interest = _f(data.get("Other Interest"))
    epf_interest = _f(data.get("EPF Taxable Interest"))
    other_sources_total = (savings_interest + deposit_interest
                           + other_interest + epf_interest)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Capital gains (gross)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    stcg_111a = 0.0
    ltcg_112a_gross = 0.0
    ltcg_other = 0.0
    stcg_other = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}
    ltcg_non_equity = {"Bonds": 0.0, "Debentures": 0.0, "G-Secs": 0.0, "Mutual Funds": 0.0}

    # Listed shares
    for txn in data.get("Stock Sale Transactions") or []:
        quantity = _f(txn.get("Quantity"))
        sale_value = _f(txn.get("Sale Price")) * quantity
        cost_value = _f(txn.get("Cost Price")) * quantity
        fmv = _f(txn.get("FMV as of 31 Jan 2018")) * quantity
        if fmv > cost_value:                      # grandfathering for pre-2018 buys
            cost_value = fmv
        gain = (sale_value - cost_value
                - _f(txn.get("Brokerage")) - _f(txn.get("STT")))
        months = _months_between(_parse_date(txn.get("Purchase Date")),
                                 _parse_date(txn.get("Sale Date")))
        if months > 12:
            ltcg_112a_gross += gain
        else:
            stcg_111a += gain

    # Mutual funds
    for txn in data.get("Mutual Fund Transactions") or []:
        fund_type = str(txn.get("Type", "")).strip().lower()
        gain = _f(txn.get("Sale Value")) - _f(txn.get("Purchase Value"))
        months = _months_between(_parse_date(txn.get("Purchase Date")),
                                 _parse_date(txn.get("Sale Date")))
        if fund_type in ("equity", "hybrid-equity", "international"):
            if months > 12:
                ltcg_112a_gross += gain
            else:
                stcg_111a += gain
        elif fund_type in ("debt", "elss"):
            if months > 24:
                ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"] += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain
        else:                                     # gold-etf, gold-mf, others
            if months > 24:
                ltcg_other += gain
            else:
                stcg_other["Mutual Funds"] += gain

    # Bonds, debentures and G-Secs
    for key in ("Bonds", "Debentures", "G-Secs"):
        asset = data.get(key) or {}
        gain = _f(asset.get("Sale Amount")) - _f(asset.get("Purchase Amount"))
        if gain == 0:
            continue
        months = _f(asset.get("Held for duration in years")) * 12
        if months > 12:
            ltcg_non_equity[key] += gain
        else:
            stcg_other[key] += gain

    # A privately owned vehicle is a personal asset (not a capital asset
    # u/s 2(14)); its sale is therefore not a taxable capital gain.

    gross_cg_total = (stcg_111a + ltcg_112a_gross + ltcg_other
                      + sum(stcg_other.values()) + sum(ltcg_non_equity.values()))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Deductions (Chapter VI-A)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ppf = _f(data.get("PPF"))
    elss = _f(data.get("ELSS"))
    nsc = _f(data.get("NSC"))
    ssy = _f(data.get("Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana"))
    scss = _f(data.get("SCSS"))

    # 80C: PPF, EPF (employee), ELSS, NSC, SSY, SCSS ...
    ded_80c = min(LIMIT_80C, ppf + sec16_ii + elss + nsc + ssy + scss)

    # 80CCC: pension scheme premium.  A lump sum covering more than one year
    # is deductible in the year of payment, subject to the Rs. 50,000 cap.
    pension = data.get("Pension Scheme Premium") or {}
    pension_amount = _f(pension.get("Amount"))
    ded_80ccc = min(LIMIT_80CCC, pension_amount) if pension_amount > 0 else 0.0

    # 80CCD(1) / 80CCD(1B) / 80CCD(2)
    nps = data.get("NPS") or {}
    tier1_self = _f(nps.get("Tier-1 Self Contribution"))
    tier1_employer = _f(nps.get("Tier-1 Employer Contribution"))
    ded_80ccd1 = min(LIMIT_80CCD1, tier1_self)
    # 80CCD(1B) is an *additional* 50,000 over and above 80CCD(1).
    ded_80ccd1b = min(LIMIT_80CCD1B, tier1_self)
    ded_80ccd2 = min(LIMIT_80CCD2_RATE * (basic + dearness), tier1_employer)

    # 80D: health insurance
    self_family_total = 0.0
    parents_senior_total = 0.0
    parents_other_total = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Health Insurance") or []:
        paid_by = str(entry.get("Paid By", "self")).strip().lower()
        if paid_by != "self":
            continue                      # employer / group cover is not eligible
        amount = _f(entry.get("Amount"))
        years = _f(entry.get("Number of Years Paid")) or 1
        amount *= years                   # multi-year premium paid in one go
        beneficiary = str(entry.get("Beneficiary", "self")).strip().lower()
        beneficiary_age = _f(entry.get("Beneficiary Age"), age)
        purpose = str(entry.get("Payment Purpose", "")).strip().lower()
        if "preventive" in purpose or "checkup" in purpose:
            cap = 6000 if beneficiary_age >= 60 else 5000
            amount = min(amount, cap)
        if beneficiary in ("parents", "parent"):
            if beneficiary_age >= 60:
                parents_senior_total += amount
            else:
                parents_other_total += amount
        else:
            self_family_total += amount
    self_family_cap = 50000 if age >= 60 else 25000
    ded_80d = (min(self_family_cap, self_family_total)
               + min(50000, parents_senior_total)
               + min(25000, parents_other_total))

    # 80E: education loan interest (allowed for 8 years from repayment)
    education = data.get("Education Loan Interest") or {}
    edu_interest = _f(education.get("Interest Paid"))
    edu_year = _f(education.get("Year of Repayment"))
    ded_80e = edu_interest if (edu_year <= 0 or edu_year <= LIMIT_80E_YEARS) else 0.0

    # 80G: donations
    gross_income_for_80g = net_salary + other_sources_total + gross_cg_total
    ded_80g = 0.0
    for donation in data.get("Donations") or []:
        amount = _f(donation.get("Amount"))
        if amount <= 0:
            continue
        mode = str(donation.get("Mode", "cheque")).strip().lower()
        scheme = str(donation.get("Scheme Name", "")).strip().lower()
        if mode == "cash":
            if amount >= 2000:
                continue                  # cash donation of Rs. 2,000 or more
            if scheme in DONATION_RATES_100:
                continue                  # PM CARES cannot be paid in cash
        if scheme in DONATION_RATES_100:
            rate = 1.0
        elif scheme in DONATION_RATES_50:
            rate = 0.5
        elif age >= 60 or amount >= 0.02 * gross_income_for_80g:
            rate = 1.0                    # 100% with qualifying limit
        else:
            rate = 0.5
        ded_80g += amount * rate

    # 80TTA: savings bank interest
    if age < 60:
        tta_cap = 10000
    elif age < 80:
        tta_cap = 50000
    else:
        tta_cap = 100000
    ded_80tta = min(tta_cap, savings_interest)

    # 80TTB: interest on deposits by senior citizens
    if age >= 60:
        ttb_cap = 50000 if age < 80 else 100000
        ded_80ttb = min(ttb_cap, deposit_interest)
    else:
        ded_80ttb = 0.0

    if regime == "new":
        # New regime: most Chapter VI-A deductions are not available.
        ded_80c = 0.0
        ded_80ccc = 0.0
        ded_80ccd1 = 0.0
        ded_80d = 0.0
        ded_80e = 0.0
        ded_80g = 0.0
        ded_80tta = 0.0
        ded_80ttb = 0.0
        # 80CCH (Agnivarsh) additional NPS relief is reported under the
        # 80CCD(1B) line as the schema has no dedicated key for it.
        ded_80ccd1b = min(LIMIT_80CCD1B, tier1_self)

    total_deductions = (ded_80c + ded_80ccc + ded_80ccd1 + ded_80ccd1b
                        + ded_80ccd2 + ded_80d + ded_80e + ded_80g
                        + ded_80tta + ded_80ttb)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Capital losses and the s.112A exemption
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    stcl = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Short Term Capital Loss") or []:
        if _usable_loss(entry.get("Financial Year")):
            stcl += _f(entry.get("Loss Amount"))
    ltcl = 0.0
    for entry in data.get("Long Term Capital Loss") or []:
        if _usable_loss(entry.get("Financial Year")):
            ltcl += _f(entry.get("Loss Amount"))

    exemption_112a = 0.0
    if APPLY_112A_TOTAL_INCOME_LIMIT:
        # Probe: total income computed before the s.112A exemption.
        probe = _set_off_capital_losses(stcg_111a, stcg_other, ltcg_112a_gross,
                                        ltcg_non_equity, ltcg_other, stcl, ltcl)
        probe_income = (net_salary + other_sources_total
                        + probe[0] + probe[2] + probe[3] + probe[4]
                        + sum(probe[1].values()) - total_deductions)
        limit = LTCG_112A_LIMIT_NEW if regime == "new" else LTCG_112A_LIMIT_OLD
        if probe_income <= limit:
            exemption_112a = min(LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION, max(0.0, ltcg_112a_gross))
    else:
        exemption_112a = min(LTCG_112A_EXEMPTION, max(0.0, ltcg_112a_gross))

    ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a_gross - exemption_112a
    stcg_111a, stcg_other, ltcg_112a, ltcg_non_equity, ltcg_other = \
        _set_off_capital_losses(stcg_111a, stcg_other, ltcg_112a,
                                ltcg_non_equity, ltcg_other, stcl, ltcl)

    stcg_other_total = sum(stcg_other.values())
    ltcg_non_equity_total = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Totals
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    gross_total_income = (net_salary + other_sources_total + stcg_111a
                          + stcg_other_total + ltcg_112a
                          + ltcg_non_equity_total + ltcg_other)
    total_taxable_income = max(0.0, gross_total_income - total_deductions)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Tax computation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    slabs = _new_regime_slabs() if regime == "new" else _old_regime_slabs(age)

    ordinary_income = (total_taxable_income - stcg_111a - ltcg_112a
                       - ltcg_non_equity_total - ltcg_other)
    tax_at_slab = _slab_tax(ordinary_income, slabs)
    tax_stcg_111a = RATE_STCG_111A * stcg_111a
    tax_stcg_other = _slab_tax(stcg_other_total, slabs)
    tax_ltcg_112a = RATE_LTCG_112A * ltcg_112a
    tax_ltcg_non_equity = RATE_LTCG_OTHER * ltcg_non_equity_total
    tax_ltcg_other = RATE_LTCG_OTHER * ltcg_other

    total_tax_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab + tax_stcg_111a + tax_stcg_other
                                + tax_ltcg_112a + tax_ltcg_non_equity
                                + tax_ltcg_other)
    rebate = _rebate_87a(total_tax_before_rebate, total_taxable_income, regime)
    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate
    surcharge = _surcharge(tax_after_rebate, total_taxable_income, regime)
    cess = CESS_RATE * (tax_after_rebate + surcharge)
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess
    tds = _f(data.get("TDS"))
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - tds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Output
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": _r(gross_salary),
            "Exemptions": {
                "Section 10(13A)": _r(exempt_hra),
                "Section 10(5)": _r(exempt_lta),
            },
            "Section 16(ia)": _r(sec16_ia),
            "Section 16(ii)": _r(sec16_ii),
            "Section 16(iii)": _r(sec16_iii),
            "Net Salary": _r(net_salary),
        },
        "Capital Gains": {
            "STCG (Section 111A)": _r(stcg_111a),
            "STCG (Other)": {
                "Bonds": _r(stcg_other["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": _r(stcg_other["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": _r(stcg_other["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": _r(stcg_other["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": _r(stcg_other_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": _r(ltcg_112a),
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": {
                "Bonds": _r(ltcg_non_equity["Bonds"]),
                "Debentures": _r(ltcg_non_equity["Debentures"]),
                "G-Secs": _r(ltcg_non_equity["G-Secs"]),
                "Mutual Funds": _r(ltcg_non_equity["Mutual Funds"]),
                "Total": _r(ltcg_non_equity_total),
            },
            "LTCG (Other)": _r(ltcg_other),
        },
        "Income from Other Sources": {
            "Savings Bank Interest": _r(savings_interest),
            "Deposit Interest": _r(deposit_interest),
            "Other Interest": _r(other_interest),
            "EPF Taxable Interest": _r(epf_interest),
        },
        "Gross Total Income": _r(gross_total_income),
        "Deductions": {
            "80C": _r(ded_80c),
            "80CCC": _r(ded_80ccc),
            "80CCD(1)": _r(ded_80ccd1),
            "80CCD(1B)": _r(ded_80ccd1b),
            "80CCD(2)": _r(ded_80ccd2),
            "80D": _r(ded_80d),
            "80E": _r(ded_80e),
            "80G": _r(ded_80g),
            "80TTA": _r(ded_80tta),
            "80TTB": _r(ded_80ttb),
            "Total Deductions": _r(total_deductions),
        },
        "Total Taxable Income": _r(total_taxable_income),
        "Tax Computation": {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": _r(tax_at_slab),
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": _r(tax_stcg_111a),
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": _r(tax_stcg_other),
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": _r(tax_ltcg_112a),

            "Tax on LTCG (Other)": _r(tax_ltcg_other),
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": _r(total_tax_before_rebate),
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": _r(rebate),
            "Tax After Rebate": _r(tax_after_rebate),
            "Surcharge": _r(surcharge),
            "Health and Education Cess": _r(cess),
            "Total Tax Liability": _r(total_tax_liability),
            "Less: TDS": _r(tds),
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": _r(net_tax),
        },
    }


def main():
    try:
        with open(INPUT_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
```
